github.description: Blazingly fast, native macOS file search powered by Rust and AppKit — like Everything for Mac

projects.summary: Lokii 是一款极致轻量、亚毫秒级响应的 macOS 原生即时文件搜索工具，致力于在 Mac 上带来类似 Windows 下 Everything 般的轻巧、瞬时文件名检索体验。 在 macOS 上，Spotlight 或访达搜索在定位文件时有时不够快速直接，或者在海量文件中难以做到纯文件名的“键入即出结果”。Lokii 采用 Rust 内存倒排索引核心（lokii-core）+ 纯原生 Swift/AppKit 前端的架构，在数十万文件规模下依然提供亚毫秒级延迟与极低的资源消耗。 核心特性 1. 亚毫秒级即时检索：输入字符的同时结果瞬时呈现在屏幕上，50 万级文件检索延迟 < 10ms，常驻内存占用极低（< 100MB）。 2. 多模式智能识别：支持纯子串匹配、通配符（, ?）、正则表达式（^...$）以及模糊拼写容错（Fuzzy）。 3. FSEvents 实时无感监听：基于 macOS 多路 FSEvents 增量事件流与防抖队列，文件增删改移与重命名实时自动同步，日常待机 CPU 开销接近为零。 4. 全键盘极速流交互： 全局快捷键呼出（⌘⇧Space） 方向键平滑导航，Enter 访达中直达定位 ⌘C 一键复制完整文件路径，Esc 瞬间隐藏退出 5. 纯原生 AppKit 视觉质感：高信息密度原生虚拟列表、自适应斑马纹、系统原生文件图标渲染与轻量视窗动效。 6. 持久化紧凑缓存：基于 bitcode 紧凑二进制格式序列化存储索引，启动瞬间热加载恢复就绪状态。 7. 100% 离线与隐私优先：纯本地运行，没有任何账号系统，零网络请求、零遥测与追踪埋点，文件名与目录结构绝不离开您的 Mac。

projects.title: Scope Photo Viewer
projects.summary: Scope is the photo organizer macOS is missing — everything Finder can't do with your photos. Sort, tag, and instantly find any photo across your whole Mac. Its viewer gives you every comfort option to look at a photo properly — but it's not an editing tool. Built around Finder's own shortcuts and gestures, so it feels familiar to everyone. 100% local: no cloud, no subscription. Free 2-hour trial, then a one-time €29.

projects.title: Voltyn
projects.summary: Voltyn shows how much power your Apple Silicon MacBook is using right now, in watts, right in the menu bar with a 60-second trend. Open the details window for 60s, 1h, 1d and 7d history, input/system/battery power flow, adapter capability, estimated battery health, temperature and cycle count. A medium desktop widget shows the last hour. Missing data is never shown as zero. Everything stays on your Mac. US$1.00 one-time, no subscription. macOS 14+.

projects.title: Tuto
projects.summary: Tuto is a web-native exam platform with anti-cheat built in. Full-screen lockdown, tab-switch tracking, clipboard blocking, and AI/plagiarism detection, all in the browser. No kernel drivers, no extensions, no IT headaches.

projects.title: CodeCrab
projects.summary: CodeCrab is a native desktop app that reviews Pull Requests in seconds using your local CLIs. 100% client-side — your code never leaves your machine.

projects.title: Rubato
projects.summary: Rubato stacks your day in order instead of pinning everything to a time. Run late and everything after shifts; finish early and it moves up. Fixed meetings stay put. iPhone + Mac (menu bar), iCloud sync, no account, one-time purchase. Free 14-day trial.

projects.title: Trader's Journal
projects.summary: The trading journal that won't let you lie to yourself. Trader's Journal is a Windows desktop app for U.S. stock traders. Import your trade history straight from your broker — once trades are in, they can't be edited or deleted. It calculates your real win rate, average win vs. average loss, and flags the psychology patterns costing you money: overtrading, revenge trading, sizing up after a loss. Free 15-day trial, no card needed — no monthly subscription.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】MeowOut：原生 macOS 菜单栏全能工具箱，附带一只守护健康的像素宠物
projects.author: huangy7

github.name: huangy7/MeowOut
github.description: A native macOS menu bar toolkit with a pixel pet that keeps you healthy. Clipboard, 2FA, dropzone, memos, snippets and a live system monitor — in one app. 原生 macOS 菜单栏工具箱，附带守护健康的像素宠物。

projects.summary: MeowOut 是一款采用 Swift 原生构建的 macOS 菜单栏多合一效率工具箱。 很多开发者平时电脑菜单栏上会挂着许多单一功能的小工具（剪贴板、2FA、系统监控、便签备忘、防休眠等），不仅占用内存和屏幕空间，切换也很繁琐。同时长时间伏案编码容易忘记喝水和休息。 MeowOut 将高频开发者日常工具深度整合进同一个原生菜单栏应用，并引入了一只可爱的像素小宠物（猫咪、熊猫、皮卡），在菜单栏陪你工作的同时提醒定时喝水、防沉迷与正念呼吸。 核心功能 1. 像素伴侣与健康守护：猫咪/熊猫/皮卡在菜单栏常驻奔跑与互动，定时提醒喝水、久坐休息，内置全屏沉浸式正念呼吸练习。 2. 剪贴板历史：完整记录纯文本、富文本与图片，支持模糊搜索、快捷粘贴、置顶收藏与历史清理。 3. 快速备忘（闪念胶囊）：原生 Markdown 备忘录，支持时间线与日历双视图，快捷键随手呼出速记窗口。 4. 文件中转站：轻量拖拽暂存区，随手拖入多格式文件、需要时随时拖出，支持内容快速预览。 5. 两步验证（TOTP 2FA）：支持主流 TOTP 算法，密钥经 macOS 原生钥匙串（Keychain）安全加密存储。 6. 实时系统与硬件监控：半透明面板实时展示 CPU、内存、网络、电池与磁盘状态，支持进程下钻与高能耗排行；支持合盖防休眠、电池保护模式与清洁锁屏模式（擦键盘防误触）。 7. 日常效率扩展： 环形快捷启动器：长按唤出光标直达的圆形多轮盘快捷启动器。 轻量基金看板：实时估值跟踪、隐私遮罩与持仓收益计算。

projects.title: Kaya, AI Coding Terminal
projects.summary: kaya brings a real terminal and AI chat into one desktop app. Run Claude Code, OpenCode, Kimi Code, and Codex in separate tabs. Use @mentions to coordinate tasks, monitor agent activity, and catch work that drifts off course. Code remotely through Feishu, Slack, or Web Remote Access. Available on macOS and Windows, with a free plan and a 7-day trial.

projects.title: ThermPort
projects.summary: A 20 MB menu bar monitor for Apple Silicon: CPU temperature, fan, memory, GPU, battery, network, disk, power and Wi‑Fi, each with a live chart. Threshold colors, alerts, 400 days of history with PDF reports. 14-day trial, one-time purchase, 18 languages.

projects.title: Extra Cup
projects.summary: A free menu bar app that stops your Mac falling asleep. One switch keeps it awake for 30 minutes, an hour, two, or until you turn it off, and the screen still sleeps as usual. Double Espresso keeps it running with the lid closed, with no display and no charger, so a download or a build carries on in your bag. No account, no subscription, no telemetry. Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later, 13 languages.

projects.title: Show HN: Use macOS shortcuts on Windows
projects.author: priomsrb
projects.summary: Hi HN! In my day to day, I switch between my Windows PC and Macbook often. One thing I find annoying is having to change what keyboard shortcuts I use depending on the OS (e.g. cmd+c vs ctrl+c for copying). It confuses my muscle memory and slows me down. I first tried using AutoHotkey to bind MacOS-like shortcuts to Windows shortcuts. This worked, but it was hard to configure. I would also have to quit AutoHotkey to get past Anti-Cheat software on some games. So I decided to create this app in case others also face the same issues as me. Disclaimer: I built this app using Claude Code. I don't have much experience building windows apps so it would've been difficult to make this on my own.

projects.title: Still
projects.summary: Still is a free, open-source macOS menu bar mixer: its own volume, mute and output device for every app and it requires no audio driver, no kernel extension, no privileged helper.

projects.title: Retro Journal Desktop Client
projects.summary: Retro Journal is a journal that thinks it's a video game. Each entry is a save of your life, the moments worth keeping become checkpoints, and writing earns XP. Today it lands on the desktop: native macOS, Windows and Linux apps that sync with the iPhone and Android ones. Local-first, so it all works offline, and every entry exports to Markdown and JSON. Nothing is locked in, ever. Free on your device. Cloud sync is $12.99 once, no subscription.

projects.title: Atlarix CLI
projects.summary: Atlarix CLI is an AI coding agent for your terminal. Run atlarix in any project and ask it to build, fix or explain something. - Five modes on shift+tab: Build, Explore, Plan, Debug, Review - Any model: Atlarix Auto, your own key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek...) or local via Ollama / LM Studio - Every edit is a diff you approve; commands run in a per-OS sandbox - Sub-agents and background jobs you can watch live - Shares sessions and keys with the Atlarix desktop app Free.

projects.title: Nexo
projects.summary: Nexo brings your team's chat, tasks, sprints, calls and guest meetings into one app, built for teams of 2–20. Turn any message into a task with assignee, due date and checklist, plan sprints with burndown charts, and jump on a voice or video call with one click. Files are encrypted at rest, each with its own key. Web app plus desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux that update themselves. Free, no card needed. Available in English and Spanish.

projects.title: BrowserDrop
projects.summary: BrowserDrop lets you access your Android files from any desktop browser over your local Wi-Fi. Pick a folder on your phone, scan a QR code, and start browsing, previewing, downloading, and uploading files. No USB cable. No cloud storage. No desktop app. No account required. Your files stay on your local network, making BrowserDrop a simple and private way to move files between Android and your computer.

projects.title: MVP launch
projects.summary: NoSnooze is a task-based alarm clock for people who keep hitting snooze. Instead of simply tapping a button to dismiss your alarm, you must complete a mission to prove you're awake — solve a math problem, shake your phone, take a photo, or complete a memory challenge. Build wake-up streaks, track your progress, and turn waking up early into a habit. No snooze. No shortcuts. Just wake up.

projects.title: Notice – Mindful Screen Time
projects.summary: Notice is a free iOS timer for mindful screen time. It sits in the Dynamic Island and works with Shortcuts so you can see how long you have been on your phone. It is about noticing how long you have been on your phone, not blocking apps. No account required.

projects.title: 做了个查 AI 用量的 App
projects.author: chenzhe
projects.summary: 做了个 App 叫 **usAge**：连上账号，用了多少、什么时候重置、还剩多少钱，一屏看清；放个小组件在桌面，抬头就能看到。 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/cover.jpg) ## 支持哪些服务 Claude 、Codex 、Cursor 、智谱 GLM / Z.ai 、Kimi 、MiniMax 、Xiaomi MiMo 、Qoder 、OpenRouter 、DeepSeek （鸿蒙版的 Qoder 在下个版本）。 - 订阅制看已用比例和重置倒计时，按量付费看余额和花销 - 网页登录或者填 API Key 都能连 - 没有你在用的？ App 里可以申请接入，直接回帖也行 ## 主要功能 - **一屏看全部额度**：5 小时窗口、每周额度、Token 消耗、账号信息，点开就有 - **五种小组件**：基础、数码管、贡献图、LED 、卡包，小中大三种尺寸，一个最多放 4 个账号。小组件上能直接切换额度、刷新，Codex 有重置卡时也能在小组件上直接用掉 - **分享卡片**：Token 战绩、额度状态、AI 花销三种，可以拿来晒 - **多设备同步**：Apple 设备走 iCloud ，华为设备走云空间，手机上连一次，其他设备自动出现 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/iphone.jpg) ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/widgets.jpg) Mac 版除了主窗口还有菜单栏，会读本机日志，显示今天 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 用了多少 Token 、大概花了多少钱； Siri 、快捷指令、聚焦搜索里也能直接查额度和刷新。 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/shots/zh-Hans/mac-detail.jpg) 鸿蒙版支持手机、平板和电脑，大屏是侧边栏两栏布局。Apple Watch 上抬腕也能看。 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/press/zh-Hans/screens/harmony-pc-status.png) ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/watch.jpg) ## 凭证安全 - 不注册也能用 - Cookie 、API Key 、OAuth 令牌只存在本机系统钥匙串里 - 查用量的请求由你的设备直接发给各服务商，**不经过我的服务器** - 同步走你自己的 iCloud / 华为云空间，凭证字段加密存储，可以随时关 - 服务器只存 usAge 账号和购买记录，用来在别的设备上恢复 Pro ## 价格 - 免费版：连接 1 个服务，所有小组件样式和分享卡片都能用 - Pro：¥15 一次买断，不限连接数量，没有订阅、没有广告 - 登录 usAge 账号后，Pro 在 Apple 、鸿蒙、安卓之间通用 - 鸿蒙首发特惠 ¥6 ，到 10 月 30 日 不想先连账号的话，设置里打开「演示数据」就能把所有界面看一遍。 ## 下载 - **Mac**：已上架 Mac App Store → https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6812881047 - **iPhone / iPad / Apple Watch**：1.1 **正在等待审核**，过审后同一个链接就能下。（ 1.0 审了 12 天还没结果，索性撤回，直接拿 1.1 首发） - **鸿蒙（手机 / 平板 / 电脑）**：今天刚上架华为应用市场 → https://appgallery.huawei.com/app/detail?id=ltd.zhe.usage - **安卓**：官网直装版 → https://usage.o-c.do/zh-Hans/android ，Google Play 版也在审核中 - 官网： https://usage.o-c.do 系统要求：iOS / iPadOS 18.6+、macOS 15.6+、watchOS 10+、HarmonyOS 6.1+、Android 12+

projects.title: Factorai
projects.summary: Fatcorai is the Agentic Development Environment (ADE) for the AI era. It is a free, community-driven, open-source desktop app for running coding agents. Sessions, not files, are the unit of work: see which agent is working or waiting on you, review its diff, search every conversation and schedule routines.

projects.title: [开源] ALTRun: 不到 1 MB 的 Windows 启动器, 操作方式参照 Alfred, 支持拼音首字母和 Everything
projects.author: zhugecaomao
projects.summary: 大家好, 分享一个我自己每天在用的小工具: ALTRun, 一个 Windows 上的启动器 (类似 macOS 的 Alfred, 以及 Windows 上的 Listary, Wox、PowerToys Run、Raycast, ALTRun(Pascal)、RunZ)。 按 `Alt+Space`, 输入几个字母, 按 `Enter`: 打开程序、找文件、算数、搜网页、翻剪贴板历史, 都在一个窗口里完成。 ![搜索窗口]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun/main/docs/images/screenshots/search.png) ## 为什么又做一个启动器 以前一直用老牌的 [ALTRun]( https://github.com/etworker/ALTRun) (etworker 用 Pascal / Delphi 写的) 和 [RunZ]( https://github.com/goreliu/runz) (AutoHotkey), 小巧顺手, 但我还想要拼音首字母、Everything 文件搜索、剪贴板历史、文字片段这些功能, 以及更现代的界面。也试过 Wox、PowerToys Run、Listary 等, 不是太大 (几十上百 MB, 常驻占内存), 就是中文支持一般, 或者和 Total Commander 配合不好。 所以用 AutoHotkey v2 重新写了一个: 名字沿用 ALTRun, 向原作致敬, 也借鉴了 RunZ 的设计; 操作方式参照 Alfred; 之后一直按自己每天的使用习惯打磨。 ## 几个特点 - **小**: 下载不到 1 MB, 解压后约 2 MB, 不需要 .NET、Electron 或其他运行库 - **便携**: 免安装、不写注册表、不需要管理员权限, 数据都在 `Data\` 文件夹里, 放 U 盘或同步盘都行 - **拼音首字母**: `wx` → 微信, `vsc` → Visual Studio Code, 匹配的字会高亮 - **越用越准**: 记住每次输入选了哪个结果, 常用的自动排前面 - **文件搜索**: 装了 Everything 就毫秒级搜全盘, 没装用内置索引; 输入 `D:\Projects\` 可以逐级浏览文件夹, `Tab` 补全 - **多合一**: 计算器 (单位、进制、日期、汇率)、网页搜索、浏览器书签、剪贴板历史 (文字 / 文件 / 图片, 可置顶)、文字片段 (`;关键字` 自动展开)、切换窗口、40 多个 Windows 设置页面、系统命令 - **全键盘**: `→` 打开操作面板 (管理员运行、打开所在位置、复制路径、属性...), `F3` 直接编辑, `Ctrl+1`~`Ctrl+9` 直接打开第 N 项 - **Total Commander 用户友好**: 打开 / 保存对话框里 `Ctrl+G` 跳到 TC 当前目录; `Insert` 标记多个文件后一起操作; 文件管理器可以设成 TC - **个性化**: 简体中文 / 繁體中文 / English / 日本語界面, 20 套内置主题, 可跟随系统深浅色 - **隐私**: 不收集任何数据, 只联网检查更新 (开启货币换算后每天下载一次汇率) | 操作面板 | 剪贴板历史 | |:---:|:---:| | ![操作面板]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun/main/docs/images/screenshots/actions.png) | ![剪贴板]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun/main/docs/images/screenshots/clipboard.png) | ## 下载和安装 - GitHub: https://github.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun (GPL-3.0, 开源免费) - 官网: https://zhugecaomao.github.io/ALTRun/ - 直接下载 [最新版本]( https://github.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun/releases/latest), 解压后运行 `ALTRun.exe` - 或者用 Scoop: `scoop bucket add altrun https://github.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun` 然后 `scoop install altrun` 装好后按 `Alt+Space`, 输入 `?` 可以看到全部用法。有新版本时搜索窗口里会提示, 按 `Enter` 就能更新。 欢迎试用和提意见, 有 bug 或想要的功能可以在这里回复, 也可以去 GitHub 提 issue。觉得好用的话, 给个 Star 就是最大的支持 🙏

projects.title: Quota
projects.summary: Quota is a free, open-source desktop app for keeping track of your AI tools without opening each provider's dashboard. It shows subscription allowances, reset times and API credit balances in your tray or a floating widget. You can add multiple accounts for integrations that support it.

projects.title: Kishi Notch
projects.summary: Kishi Notch turns your MacBook notch into an interactive island: reply to WhatsApp, Messages and Mail notifications, join your next meeting in one click, control music, run timers and see AirPods battery. Plus a detailed menu bar battery.

projects.title: Boop
projects.summary: Boop puts 24,563 kaomoji one tap away on iPhone and one shortcut away on Mac. 37 moods, instant search, saved favorites. Type "shrug", get ┐( ˘_˘)┌, in any app. Free, offline, no accounts, no ads, no tracking.

projects.title: Interview Signal
projects.summary: A desktop app for recruiters and hiring managers. During the interview: a live transcript and a question guide built from the job description, with follow-ups. After it: a scorecard where every score carries the candidate's own words, checked against the transcript, plus a client submittal in about a minute. It captures the call on your own computer, so no bot joins, on Zoom, Teams, Meet or phone. Transcripts stay on your machine. Free 20-minute trial, no card.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】nerf-watch：检查 Claude Code 和 Codex 有没有悄悄变笨或变贵
projects.author: Abelo9996

github.name: Abelo9996/nerf-watch
github.description: Find out when your coding agent quietly got worse or more expensive. Local-first checks on Claude Code and Codex session logs, no telemetry.

projects.summary: nerf-watch 读取 Claude Code 和 Codex 已经写在你电脑上的会话日志，告诉你 Agent 有没有在你没改任何设置的情况下"悄悄变了"：实际回答的模型和你选的不一样、推理强度降了、CLI 升级后每轮的缓存写入翻倍、缓存命中率掉了、工具调用出错变多。 很多人觉得"更新之后变笨了""额度掉得更快了"，但没法验证。数据其实就在本地日志里。我第一版在自己的日志上报了 6 个警告，结果全是误报（子智能体的流量混进了平均值），现在只比较主对话、要求变化在至少两个项目里都出现才报警，每条结论都写明有多少数据支撑。 完全本地运行，不联网，MIT 协议。还有一个 macOS 菜单栏小工具，变化时图标变红。 bash npx nerf-watch check

projects.title: DotQuit
projects.summary: DotQuit is an open-source, lightweight macOS menu bar utility written natively in Swift. Closing an app's last window on macOS often leaves it idling in memory. DotQuit solves this by gracefully quitting apps when their last window closes. • Native Swift with ~19MB RAM footprint • AXObserver-based gentle termination (no force-kill) • Customizable app whitelist • Apple Notarized & open source (GPLv3)

projects.title: BusinessOS
projects.summary: BusinessOS just shipped 40 free instant tools — VAT calculator, GST calculator, invoice number generator, freelance hourly rate calculator, break-even, MRR/CAC/LTV calculators, receipt generator, and 32 more. Each runs entirely in your browser, no signup, copies the answer to your clipboard. Plus the full app: private, offline-first, encrypted invoicing + expenses + reports. Voice-to-invoice in 3 seconds. WhatsApp send on every invoice. Free during limited early access.

projects.title: Review
projects.summary: Free desktop app for reviewing Git branches and GitHub PRs. Comment on any line and keep comments private until you publish. Add AI reviewers with your own models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter or local via Ollama. Split the review across a team of models, see exactly which rules each one checked, and retry only what was missed. Open source (MIT), no account, for Mac, Windows and Linux.

projects.title: IGDL
projects.summary: Save Instagram reels and photos by swapping one word IGDL downloads public Instagram reels, videos, photos and full carousels from a link, with no login and no app. The shortcut: change instagram.com to igdl.app in any post link and the download starts by itself. 26 languages, nothing stored.

projects.title: PickPDF
projects.summary: Edit PDFs in your browser without uploading them. PickPDF lets you change existing text, redact content, sign documents, fill forms, merge pages and run OCR on scans. Use the built-in on-device AI to summarize and explain your PDF. Start free with no account. Desktop apps are available for Windows, macOS and Linux, plus Chrome and Edge extensions. Optional external AI connections send context to your chosen provider.

It also does local push-to-talk dictation (Whisper or Parakeet, nothing leaves the Mac). Free, MIT, Rust + Swift. macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon, plus a Windows build.

projects.summary: 自荐一个 MIT 开源桌面工具：HRouter Desktop，用于集中管理 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编程工具的供应商配置和模型线路。 做这个工具的起因是频繁切换模型：Claude Code 一份配置，Codex 一份，Gemini CLI 又是一份，每次换供应商都要重新找 Key、端点和模型映射，改完还担心覆盖原有配置。我希望把这些接入操作集中到一个工作台，让使用者少折腾配置，多专注编程。 主要功能 统一接入工作台：覆盖 Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Codex、Gemini CLI、OpenCode 等 11 个 Agent；可接入官方供应商、自建端点和兼容服务。 先看变更，再切配置：主动开启 Claude / Codex 配置保护后，可保留自定义字段、预览变更、保存本地快照，并在恢复前检查冲突。 为模型准备备用线路：配置主备供应商及精确模型路由，在支持的本地代理模式下自动故障转移。不同 Agent 的支持范围不同，并非全部都支持代理接管。 常用配置存成方案：保存供应商、MCP、Skills 的选择，重新应用前先检查。接入方案不等于完整配置备份。 用量可视化：查看请求、Token、缓存和本地费用估算，提供浮动用量窗口与 macOS 桌面小组件。费用估算仅供参考，不是供应商账单。 使用桌面工具不需要 HRouter 账户，也不要求使用 HRouter 服务；可自行选择已有供应商。 界面预览 以 Agent 为中心的接入工作台： 模型线路与备用供应商管理： 与 CC Switch 的关系 项目基于 Jason Young 及贡献者开发的 CC Switch，保留原作者版权与 MIT 许可证，独立维护，不是上游官方发行版。 上游的供应商、代理、MCP、Skills、会话和用量基础能力仍然保留；本分支主要围绕 Agent 优先的界面、配置保护流程、可复用的接入方案、精确模型主备链和兼容性修复进行扩展，不将继承能力包装为新发明。这是本分支的改动说明，不代表当前上游缺少所有对应能力。 下载与

projects.title: 【开源自荐】atv-core：用 iPhone 自带的 Apple TV 遥控器控制 Android TV 和 Mac
projects.author: corvofeng
projects.summary: atv-core 让 iPhone 控制中心自带的 Apple TV 遥控器，可以直接操控 Android TV 和 Mac。手机端无需安装额外 App，也不需要购买 Apple TV。 图文介绍与使用指南 我是项目作者，做它是为了方便在沙发上控制电视，以及接在客厅电视上的 Mac mini。找不到电视遥控器时，可以直接从手机控制中心调出遥控器；用 Mac 看视频或听音乐时，也可以随手移动鼠标、调音量和控制播放。 使用时，在电视或 Mac 上安装接收程序，手机与目标设备接入 同一局域网，再从 iPhone 遥控器中选择设备并配对即可。iPhone 端无需安装，电视或 Mac 端需要安装接收程序。 iPhone：找到遥控器，开始使用 从屏幕右上角下滑打开控制中心，点击「Apple TV 遥控器」，选择已运行接收程序的设备并完成配对，就可以滑动和点按操作。 | 找到遥控器 | 使用遥控器 | | :---: | :---: | | | | Android TV 端效果 接收程序显示配对信息和连接状态。连接后，滑动手机触控板即可移动电视界面的焦点，点按确认打开当前项目。 | 接收程序 | 电视桌面 | 焦点移动后 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | | | | Mac 端效果 Mac 端提供菜单栏应用，手机触控板可以用于移动鼠标，也支持方向键模式和媒体控制。下面是操作时的 Web 面板预览，可以查看触控轨迹、按键事件和音量状态。 | Mac 端操作预览：触控轨迹与遥控状态 | | :---: | | | 主要功能： Android TV：滑动触控板移动焦点，支持确认、返回、主页及媒体控制。 macOS：将触控板操作转换为鼠标移动，也支持方向键模式、音量调节和播放控制。 局域网连接：手机与目标设备在同一局域网内完成发现和配对。 实现原理很简单：在 Android TV 或 Mac 上模拟 Apple TV 的通信服务，接收 iPhone 发来的遥控事件，再转换为目标设备的按键、鼠标或媒体操作。项目以 MIT 协议开源。 目前提供 Android APK，以及 Apple Silicon、Intel Mac 的 DMG 安装包。首次使用需要配置相应权限：Mac 需要 辅助功能权限；Android TV 根据输入模式配置 ADB 调试和无障碍服务，详细步骤见项目文档。不同电视系统的权限入口和功能支持可能有所差异。 项目源码 安装包下载 欢迎有类似使用场景的朋友尝试，并反馈设备兼容性和使用问题。

projects.summary: 一句话分工： Herdr = 让 Agent 一直跑着、并排管理 Herduck = 记住一项活的目标 / 做到哪了 / 卡在哪 / 下一步，以及能翻回去的记录 互补，不替代。 官网 https://www.herduck.com 仓库 https://github.com/wenhanweime/herduck 上一帖 https://www.v2ex.com/t/1243952 GitHub Discussion （求反馈） https://github.com/wenhanweime/herduck/discussions/2 也在 Herdr Show and tell 发了一帖： https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr/discussions/4822 已有能力（还很早期）： - 工作 / Agents / 项目 / 会话 四个入口 - 相关对话尽量自动收拢到同一项活（可配置；也有偏本地关键词的路径） - Agent 会话自动起名；闲置一段时间可睡眠，释放内存 - herduck 命令让 Agent 读 / 更新工作计划 - 兼容 Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode / Pi / Gemini CLI / Cursor ；快捷键尽量跟 Herdr 对齐 本轮对外动作： - 仓库 homepage 指向 herduck.com - README 首屏补了官网链接和 Demo 占位 - 开了反馈 Discussion 仍已知的坑：源码安装需要 Rust / Zig / just ； macOS 需按文档重签名；早期不稳定点欢迎 Issue 。 求反馈： 1. 自动把对话归到同一项活，误伤多不多？ 2. 闲着就睡的阈值是否合理？ 3. 和纯 Herdr 并用时，哪些界面显得重复？ 安装最短路径： ``` git clone https://github.com/wenhanweime/herduck.git cd herduck just install herduck ``` 欢迎 star / Issue / 一起维护。给 Herdr 用户补「隔天接得上」，不是抢跑 Agent 那一层。 少数派长文已投稿待审（大白话版）：多开 Agent 几天后，最烦的是隔天接不上

projects.title: Show HN: Quiet – exploring when an AI assistant should intervene
projects.author: roger05
projects.summary: I’m Ruggiero, a CS student working on a research project about humanComputer interaction and AI. I built QUIET because I’ve been thinking about a problem with current AI interfaces: they usually either wait for an explicit prompt, or try to take over a task. I wanted to explore a different relationship between humans and AI: an assistant that can understand when to stay out of the way, when to point something out, when to teach, and when to act. I’ve built a small interactive demo of this idea. It’s obviously still very early, and I want to understand whether the interaction itself makes sense before trying to build the actual AI system behind it. The prototype is intentionally not AI-powered yet. The four examples are scripted so I can test the interaction itself before spending time building the underlying AI system. The idea is that the assistant can choose different levels/forms of intervention: * stay silent * point at something * explain / teach * do the task The important question for me isn’t whether an AI can perform these actions. Current systems can already do many of them. I’m trying to understand whether an assistant that decides when and how much to intervene is actually useful. I’d particularly like feedback on: * Did the interventions feel helpful or annoying? * Would you want an assistant to behave this way? * When would you prefer it to teach you rather than do something for you? * Does this interaction model make sense even without the AI being there yet? I started working on this because I feel there is an increasing gap between what computers/AI are capable of and what users actually understand and can make use of. At the same time, AI systems are becoming increasingly capable of explaining and performing tasks for us. I’m interested in whether the interface itself should evolve to bridge that gap. Demo: https://quiet-hci.pages.dev I’d really appreciate any criticism, especially if you think the interaction model doesn’t make sense. The demo suit best the desktop screens on phones Im working on a totally different but also similar idea of interaction, and since this is a simulation of the desktop tool it should work best on it , Thank You <3

projects.title: Show HN: Beyond "chat with your database" – agentic data exploration
projects.author: sandhya6
projects.summary: Business intelligence is changing. AI can now do more than turn a question into a single SQL query: it can investigate a question through a series of queries, examining the result of one query to decide what to query next. Today, to answer a business question against a database, analysts use a tool like Tableau: they select relevant data, build an initial view using fields, filters, calculations, and visualizations, then look for patterns or anomalies. They form hypotheses and test them — filtering by region, drilling into customer cohorts, comparing time periods, or creating calculations to validate or rule out an explanation. They repeat this process until the evidence supports an answer, then save a workbook or dashboard for others to review and monitor. With a single question, AI can now perform much of this exploratory loop: it can investigate the data, follow the evidence through multiple queries, and present the supporting analysis. This is agentic data analysis — AI autonomously decides what to investigate next based on the results it has already found. Reportr puts agentic AI at the center of the experience, then builds complementary capabilities around it to address AI's limitations: SEMANTIC LAYER Production databases are rarely clean: columns that are no longer used, cryptic names like status2, misc, or flag, columns whose meaning has quietly shifted over time, tables that linger long after their purpose is gone, and so on. This is known as schema rot. AI tools guess wrong against schemas like this. Reportr's semantic layer lets you give tables and columns business-friendly names and descriptions, document relationships, capture business rules, and flag what AI should ignore — so it's working from what your data means, not just what it's called. USER OVERSIGHT AI-generated answers can be wrong. Reportr lets you inspect the SQL executed to arrive at an answer. It also provides explanations of what the SQL does (understandable by business users), and how it works (intended for technical users). You can review the analysis rather than simply accepting AI's conclusions. BETTER USER EXPERIENCE Reportr UI is specifically optimized for chatting with a database. Database queries often return large number of records. Ask which customers haven't placed an order in the last 90 days, and the answer is a list of customers. Reportr displays tabular data in an interactive grid that can handle thousand of records without breaking a sweat. The grid supports sorting, searching, and filtering. REPORTS AND DASHBOARDS Chat is ephemeral. Every conversation starts fresh, and that's fine for exploration — but not for information you need every week. When a chart or table reveals something worth tracking, save it as a report. Combine reports into dashboards to monitor changes over time, share findings, and keep important insights accessible without having to ask the same questions again. ROLE BASED ACCESS CONTROL Not everyone on your team needs the same level of access. Reportr's role-based access control lets you give each user exactly the permissions they need — from view-only access to report building, database management, and full administrative control. CENTRALIZED MANAGEMENT Reportr is a web application — there's nothing to install, nothing to update, and no desktop app to manage across your team. Database connection strings, AI keys, are all managed centrally. Reportr can connect to all supported databases directly, MCP servers and drivers are not needed. INSTALL ON-PREMISE Reportr can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, ensuring your data never touches our servers. You can supply your own AI API key. Your data will not be used for training AI models. If you use Claude on AWS Bedrock, Amazon additionally guarantees that your data is never stored or used for training — and Bedrock is HIPAA eligible. GIVE IT A WHIRL Visit https://reportr.com to give it a try. We look forward to getting your feedback. Reportr is easy to try: you can provision a sample database with the press of a button and start asking questions right away. Or connect your own database and analyze your own data. You can ask up to five questions for free.

projects.title: Show HN: Open-source model routing for coding agents at Astra-level performance
projects.author: adchurch
projects.summary: A few months ago we started building a model router for coding agents because we thought we could outperform any single model with an ensemble approach. Recently we’ve achieved that milestone and I want to talk about how we did it. First of all, a quick explanation: the Weave Router ( https://github.com/weave-os/router ) plugs into any coding agent (e.g. Claude Code or Codex) and intelligently switches between LLMs. So, for example, Astra handles tricky debugging or complex system design tasks, and Deepseek v4 Flash handles simple frontend updates. What we’re announcing today is our new routing model, which we’re calling Weave Router 2.0. We benchmarked 2.0 against GPT-6 Astra on Terminal Bench 4.0 and SWE Atlas. On both benchmarks, the router had equivalent pass rates. On Terminal Bench, the router hit 52% of Astra’s cost, and completed tasks 2.2x faster. On SWE Atlas, the router cost 54% as much as Astra and ran 2.5x faster. (Full results on our website at https://weaveos.com/router !) It turns out training a model to route effectively - taking into consideration model capabilities, costs, cache awareness, and more - is a really hard problem! I want to talk about three ways we were able to improve so much over the last few months: 1) a new architecture, 2) larger training data set size, and 3) smarter cache-eviction impact calculation. 1) a new architecture. Our initial approach used an RL model without many priors. While RL is still an important part of the story, the cost of fully exploring the space of routing decisions is very high, so we’ve taken some shortcuts that have significantly improved performance. Consider how large the search space for the routing problem is. Take a typical coding agent session, with ~100 agent turns (i.e. 100 LLM API calls). Technically there are 100 chances to select a model. If we assume a roster of ~10 models (of course there are lots more but we can remove any that are Pareto dominated), then there are 10^100 possible paths through that session. We simply cannot explore all of them! So that's why clever tricks to shrink this space are so important. In particular: we trained a hidden Markov model to trace the session state, then a classifier maps the session to one of a few buckets of similar models. Using the HMM allows us to evaluate not just where a session is currently, but how it got there . We've gotten significantly better performance on bucket selection by incorporating that information - we believe this is because two sessions that might look quite similar to a naive classifier are much better distinguished by this HMM approach. Using this HMM + classifier to select a bucket first significantly shrinks the space to explore, by throwing out most models that could not reasonably serve the given session. This rearchitecture was the single biggest performance unlock! 2) larger training data set size (much less technically interesting but still an important part of the story). By using frontier LLMs to help us label a larger and more diverse set of coding agent sessions, we were able to bootstrap the two models discussed in 1) to a better state, while also providing even richer reward signals for RL. 3) smarter cache-eviction impact calculation. One of the hardest parts of routing well (if you care about saving money) is using the model caches intelligently. We built a subsystem that can calculate the expected value of switching models (and thus paying a high one-time cost to fill up a different cache) much more accurately, helping us avoid costly and unnecessary switches in more cases, while still switching when the benefit outweighs the cost. This is where most of our improvement on cost has come from. We still have a lot of room to continue to improve (we won’t rest until we’re consistently beating Astra/Fable, not just tying!) but matching frontier model performance was a huge milestone for our routing model, and in my opinion validates our initial hypothesis that an ensemble of models can do better than any single model ever could. Our router is open source ( https://github.com/weave-os/router ) so anyone can try it out. Or if you prefer you can use our hosted version ( https://weaveos.com/router ).

projects.title: [开源推荐] Speech Wingman：中英混说的离线语音与自定义提醒

projects.summary: Speech Wingman 让你用自然语言写下讲话时想注意的规则，在 Apple Silicon Mac 上本地识别中英混合发言，并在命中时给出原话和简短提醒。新版支持每行独立规则、随发言语言切换提醒，以及桌面悬浮按钮。运行无需云端服务，适合演讲和沟通练习；当前是需要自行构建的源码预览版。 亮点 项目维护者自荐，更新至 0.3.0 源码预览。 离线与隐私： 转录和规则推理在本机完成。应用及辅助进程使用 macOS 沙盒，没有网络权限；不会自动保存录音或会话转录，无需运行时账号或 API key。 独立规则： 每行是一条单独判断的条件，例如“说到 banana 就提醒”和“说汤姆坏话就提醒，赞扬不提醒”。模型只看当前定稿片段，不发送累计对话历史。 中英混说与桌面控制： 同一识别器处理中文、英文和混合发言；提醒语言跟随当前发言。可拖动的悬浮按钮一键开始或停止监听。 可学习的实现： SwiftUI/AppKit + Silero VAD + SenseVoiceSmall + Qwen3 4B，包含音频分段、跨进程推理、逐条规则检查、过期结果取消与引用校验。 有范围的验证： 本次 28 条合成文本用例、14 组核心测试通过；早期短句音频测试约 1 秒出现首段转录（Apple M4 / 16 GB、模型已加载）。这不是提醒延迟或真实场景准确率保证；提醒还需要额外推理时间。 当前需要自行构建，没有现成或公证安装包。要求 Apple Silicon / macOS 14+，建议 16 GB 内存；首次开发准备需要联网下载依赖和模型，构建完成后离线运行。多条规则和长发言可能延迟提醒，模型会有漏报或误报。源码 MIT，模型权重适用各自上游许可，包括 SenseVoiceSmall 的 FunASR 模型协议。

projects.title: 分享一个开源的本机 AI 网关：中转、国产模型、Claude Code、Codex 放在一起管，每个请求花了多少钱都看得到
projects.author: Faz
projects.summary: 先说适合谁：同时用 Claude Code 、Codex ，手上有好几个中转或国产模型的 key ，被 CC Switch 切换折腾过的，可以试试。 ![概览]( https://thinkwat.ch/lite/overview.webp) ## 之前用 CC Switch 的几个痛点 - **切上游总要重启客户端。（ proxy 模式也没有特别好用）** - **Codex 初始化时输入的 key 被它学了过去，结果上游直接炸了。（好像最近修了）** - **Codex 换了供应商，旧会话就接不上**（[#7257]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7257)，四十多楼，还开着）。 - **路由弱，切换也不方便。** 一个客户端同时只能用一个供应商；按模型分给不同家（[#3703]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/3703)）挂了快四个月没有维护者回复；负载均衡标了不做，理由是会丢缓存（[#842]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/842)）；按供应商单独设代理，3.14 起还被去掉了（[#2243]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/2243)）。 - **设计和产品力差。** 界面不好看，交互也乱。功能越堆越多：十个客户端、MCP 、Skills 、提示词、会话、用量、几十个供应商预设（里面还有赞助商），核心的切换和路由反而没做好。 - **中转能看到你发出去的全部内容**，它发出前不做任何检查（[#7357]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7357) 还开着）。 ## 换成 ThinkWatch Lite 之后 思路不一样：客户端只接一次，指向本机的网关，之后的事都在网关里做。 - **切中转不用重启**：换上游、调路由都在网关里完成，客户端的配置不再动。手动选择的策略组在菜单栏或托盘里就能切。 - **配置只写一次**：接管时只改指向网关的那几项，写之前给完整 diff 、备份原文件，随时能还原。客户端只拿到一把网关专用的 key ，原来的 key 和登录信息不会被导入或拿去用。 - **Codex 会话不再拆开**：Codex 只认一个 provider ，换上游不影响会话列表（接管前的旧会话仍在原来那边）。 - **路由够用**：按模型、token 数、工具、图片、思考等条件分给不同的上游，也能改写模型名；故障转移、轮询、延迟最低、费用最低都有。轮询时同一个会话固定在同一个上游，缓存照常命中。 - **什么格式都能接**：Anthropic 、OpenAI Chat 、Responses 、Gemini 四种格式互相转换。Claude Code 能用 GPT 、Gemini ，Codex 能接只有 Chat 接口的中转。 - **每个请求看得清**：费用、token 、缓存命中、首 token 时间、生成速度，走了哪条规则、依次试了哪几个上游，完整的请求和响应都在。中转可以按倍率计价，请求还能重放到另一个上游对照。菜单栏直接显示今天花了多少，GLM Coding Plan 、ChatGPT 的额度也能看。 - **省套餐额度**：Claude Code 自己发的标题生成、预热这类辅助请求，可以由网关本地应答，不发给上游。 - **中转收不到你的 key**：发出前把 API key 、token 、私钥等换成占位符，响应里回显时再换回来；模型让客户端执行「下载后执行」「外发环境变量」这类命令时，在流式输出中途切断。默认只记录、不拦截，看过日志确认没有误报再打开。 一键接管的客户端：Claude Code 、Codex （包括 ChatGPT 桌面版里的 Codex ）、opencode 、Claude Desktop 、Zed 、Aider 、DeepSeek Harness ； Cursor 、Continue 、Antigravity CLI 有手动配置的说明。Windows 上 WSL 里的 Claude Code 、Codex 也能接（ WSL 1 或 mirrored 网络）。网关还能装在 Linux 服务器上，由桌面端远程管理。 ![流量]( https://thinkwat.ch/lite/traffic.webp) ## 安装 - macOS （ Apple 芯片）：`brew install --cask thinkwatchproject/tap/thinkwatch-lite` - Linux：`curl -fsSL https://github.com/ThinkWatchProject/ThinkWatch-Lite/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh` - Windows （ x64 、ARM64 ）： https://thinkwat.ch/zh-CN/lite/#install GitHub： https://github.com/ThinkWatchProject/ThinkWatch-Lite （ MIT ，数据都在本机，不收集使用数据） 用着有问题，或者想要哪个客户端、上游，欢迎在楼里说。

projects.title: Show HN: Chow, a FOSS food diary
projects.author: sltr
projects.summary: Hi HN. Today I'm showing off Chow.fit, a plain-text FOSS food diary written in Gleam. You can self-host it with the Dockerfile or just use the one I host on chow.fit. Why does the world need another food diary app? Well, I can't speak for the whole world, but as for me: I used MyFitnessPal back in 2017-2019. It was mostly tolerable with an ad blocker. A month ago due to numbers I didn't like, I wanted to start tracking calories again. I quickly noticed that in the MFP android app, the barcode scanner is now a paid feature. It felt like paying to use my own phone camera. Their web app is slow and stuck in 2013, so I made my own web app which better aligns with my values and goals. I've lost 5% of my body weight! I like to call an app like this "un-SaaS" because it subverts a lot of the usual SaaS playbook. - Distraction-free. No AI, no ads, no tracking, no engagement-hancing e.g. no activity/news feed. It logs food and gets out of the way. - All features except sync work without a subscription. - An optional subscription enables sync. A year covers my hosting costs and buys me a T-shirt. - Sync is local-first. You can still log food e.g. in an airplane. The app syncs up when you go back online. - If you stop the subscription, the app keeps working without sync. - Your data is plain text files on your device. When SparkPeople shut down in 2021, its users could only download their daily totals. They lost everything else. That can't happen with Chow. - It uses public food data (FDC and OFF), not proprietary - It can import from MyFitnessPal using a bookmarklet to get your auth token which stays local. - It has a desktop app, Android/iOS app, and a CLI. None currently shipped, but you can build from source. Folks who track what they eat: Let me know what else you'd like to see!

github.description: Codex 保安：OpenAI Codex 本机安全审计。实时发现高危命令、凭据访问、提示注入与投毒篡改；只读日志，不代理、不装证书。

projects.summary: Codex 保安是一款 Windows 桌面工具，只读 Codex 自己写在 ~/.codex/sessions 的会话日志，实时检查它执行的命令、改动的文件和读进上下文的内容，发现提权、删库、读取凭据、数据外传、提示注入和配置投毒就提醒你。不代理流量、不装证书、不改任何配置。 亮点 只读日志：不走代理、不装根证书、不改 Codex / CC Switch 配置，删掉不留痕迹 提示注入识别：命令输出、网页、MCP 返回里写给 AI 的指令，包括不可见 Unicode 和 Markdown 图片外带 配置体检：检查 AGENTS.md、config.toml、技能、放行规则、MCP 配置有没有被投毒，并记录哈希对比变化 模型审计：配合 CC Switch 对比请求模型和上游自报模型，发现中转站偷换小模型 每条记录附触发片段、完整命令、所在会话和建议；检测引擎用 Rust 编写并单独测试，MIT 开源

projects.title: Show HN: A simple script to stop all cold sales emails from reaching your inbox
projects.author: pancomplex
projects.summary: Hey HN! Sharing this script I've been using professionally and personally to stop the crazy influx of cold emails that I get daily. It works in the following way: 1. Copy + install the Google Apps script in your Gmail. The script runs every 10 minutes by default. 2. The script will automatically use a series of Regexes as a first line of defense (modify as you like!). If that fails it will use an LLM of your choice to make the call (this is optional but highly effective). 3. Flagged emails skip the inbox and get tagged with a "Cold email" label. Nothing gets deleted. From running this for the past couple of weeks, it catches 99% of all cold emails and helps me stay in flow state. Hope this helps other people too!

projects.title: Show HN: Carve – An open-source Mac agent with a choice of models
projects.author: davidajackson
projects.summary: Hi HN, I built and open-sourced Carve to handle repetitive work in windows you already use. Choose the window in any Mac app where you want it to work, press Option-D, and watch it do what you want. For example, in the demo I show an example CRM and Carve entering contact details and drafting a follow up. It also has the ability to annotate and explain items on the screen. This runs with your own API keys, and can even support OpenRouter, though OpenAI is the best tested. Experimental adapters also for Bedrock, Azure. No reason it couldn't expand beyond experimental support to support more local models. I built this because I found that Claude and Codex were rather clunky when using computer use, I like having a sleek window that just pops up and shows me what it's doing. Also it has the 3 similar modes (approve plan, step by step manual approval, or act directly mode). Local currently covers browser actions via vision models, computer use support is required for operating other native mac apps. This is an ongoing area of work. I'm seeing a lot of demand for local model support and building out relevant tooling so wanted to contribute. We're just now at the point where models are getting fast and smart enough to make rapid computer use possible. You can take a look at the benchmarks in the repository, Carve currently can rapidly and cheaply handle explaining, summarizing, basic navigation, and extraction. Complex, long horizon tasks are a work in progress, though I'm seeing promising results. Failures resemble patterns, and you can identify patterns and fix them by running evaluations in batches. I'd love any feedback on how well the tool works, what you tried, and any issues that you found. Thank you!

projects.title: 开源 Bibo：成本极低，内置笔记、文件、任务和日历的 personal agent
projects.author: Peiiii
projects.summary: 我把 Bibo 开源了，MIT 协议。先说最想做好的三件事： 1. **成本极低。** 日常使用不需要常驻电脑，也不用一直开着 Linux 容器。只有需要运行代码时，才启动沙箱。 2. **内置个人管理工具。** 笔记、文件、任务和日历都有专门的界面。你可以直接查看、编辑和管理，也可以让 AI 来做。 3. **开源，可以自己部署。** 用自己的 Cloudflare 账号和模型 API Key ，数据存在自己的部署里，代码也可以自己改。 GitHub：[Peiiii/bibo]( https://github.com/Peiiii/bibo) 在线体验：[app.bibo.bot]( https://app.bibo.bot) 我希望它能成为每天都用得上的 personal agent 。想到什么可以随手记，需要做的事可以放进任务和日历，资料可以整理成文件；这些内容长期留着，之后还能接着用。 下面把界面都放出来。截图来自实际运行的 Bibo ，销售、订单和日程内容都是示例数据。 ### 概览 打开就能看到笔记、任务、日程和待处理信息。 ![Bibo 概览]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-overview.jpg) ### 对话 让 Bibo 阅读销售数据、总结重点，也可以让它继续整理报告和安排后续工作。 ![Bibo 对话与报告]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-chat.jpg) ### 笔记 笔记是可以直接编辑的 Markdown 文档。你自己写，或者让 Bibo 帮你整理，都能继续修改。 ![Bibo 笔记]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-notes.jpg) ### 文件 有独立的文件目录，可以打开、编辑文件。这里展示的是整理好的订单 CSV 。 ![Bibo 文件]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-files.jpg) ### 任务 任务有独立列表和详情，可以管理完成状态、优先级、描述和时间。分析出来的建议，可以接着变成待办。 ![Bibo 任务]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-tasks.jpg) ### 日历 日程直接显示在日历里，可以自己添加，也可以让 Bibo 帮你安排。 ![Bibo 日历]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-calendar.jpg) ### 收件箱 需要你关注和确认的内容放在这里，可以查看并标记处理。 ![Bibo 收件箱]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-inbox.jpg) ### 需要运行代码时，按需启动 Linux 沙箱 例如，用 Python 清洗订单表，去掉重复行，生成新的 CSV 和说明文档。下面这次演示实际运行了 Python ，文件已保存。 普通对话和个人管理功能由 Cloudflare Workers / Durable Objects 承载，文件保存在 R2 。需要运行 Python 、Shell 等代码时，才用 Cloudflare Sandbox ，不必为了日常使用维持一台常驻电脑。 ![Bibo 运行 Python 整理订单]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/bibo-sandbox-execution.png) ### 手机端 手机上也能继续对话、查看和管理任务。 ![Bibo 手机对话]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/bibo-mobile-chat.png) ![Bibo 手机任务]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/bibo-mobile-tasks.png) 自己部署需要 Cloudflare Workers Paid 、R2 、Sandbox 和模型 API Key ，具体步骤在仓库 README 。实际费用由模型调用、存储和沙箱使用量决定。 欢迎试用，也欢迎提 Issue 或 PR 。想听听大家：你最希望 personal agent 帮你处理哪件日常小事？

projects.summary: 前几天我试着用本地 Agent （ Codex / Claude Code ）帮我清理堆积了 4 年、400 多个 Edge 书签，本来以为一句话的事情，结果踩了一裤裆的工程暗坑。 今天把整个过程中的反直觉真相、工程死锁以及最终跑通的解决方案开源出来。 **项目开源地址**： https://github.com/askofcc/chromium-bookmark-guardian （无需安装任何插件或第三方脚本，纯 Prompt 规范，丢给你的本地 Agent 即可现场执行） --- ### 一、 两个反直觉的认知“打脸” #### 1. 为什么“让 AI 自动整理书签目录”是个彻头彻尾的灾难？ 第一轮我让大模型根据 URL 和内容“智能重组分类”。结果它把属于我个人业务流的海外支付钱包 `WebMoney`，生硬地塞进了 `常用站长与 SEO`。 后来我想明白了：**书签本质上是人的「空间记忆」和「私人业务上下文」**。 当年我做站长要买外链，顺手需要办一张虚拟卡，所以虚拟卡自然在垂直业务目录下。AI 只有通识词向量，没有私人业务上下文。它自作聪明地按大词归类，看似整齐，实际把大脑建立了几年的空间肌肉记忆瞬间切碎，心理感受就是“东西全丢了”。 **结论：书签治理的第一铁律，是 AI 严禁触碰用户原有的目录结构。** #### 2. 传统死链工具（以及只查 HTTP 状态码的脚本）漏掉了 80% 的“假存活与黑产劫持” 市面上的扩展（如 Bookmarks Clean Up ）通常只看返回码是不是 200 ，结果这几天深度复测发现： - **域名过期被黑灰产抢注（最恶劣）**：当年存的正规电商/技术工具平台早已停业，域名过期后被黑产批量买走，变成了披着 200 状态码外衣的**涉黄非法看片站、境外博彩下注平台、或盗版影视泛站群**！ - **表面 200 ，实际为伪装 403 / 挂马跳转**：服务器 Nginx 返回 HTTP 200 ，但页面源码标题直接写着 ` 403 Forbidden `，正文是一段加密的博彩跳转脚本； - **SSL 证书域名不匹配**：老站换理解析但证书过期或域名不匹配，浏览器打开直接弹红屏隐私拦截； - **Cloudflare 致命解析错误**：如被查封的服务，返回 Cloudflare 的 `Error 1000: DNS points to prohibited IP` 错误说明页。 如果不做**语义级内容比对 + 严格证书校验**，这些已经变质的毒性链接会永久潜伏在你的日常收藏夹中。 --- ### 二、 必须绕过的底层死锁：Chromium 云同步（ Sync ）反向覆写 如果你在后台关闭 Edge/Chrome ，直接用 Python 修改磁盘上的 `Default/Bookmarks` JSON 文件： **千万别这么干！** 因为开启了微软/谷歌账号云同步后，Chromium 内部遵循硬性冲突规则 **「 Remote parent wins （云端归属优先）」**。你离线改的文件没有同步事务凭证，浏览器启动联网瞬间，云同步引擎会把云端旧目录全量拉下来覆盖你的本地修改！ **有效解法**： 通过系统自动化管道（如 macOS AppleScript / CDP ），向浏览器内部打开的 `edge://favorites` 或 `chrome://bookmarks` 注入原生脚本，直接调用浏览器内部特权接口 `chrome.bookmarks.move()`。 每一次移动都会作为原生事件被 Sync 引擎捕获并主动提交给云端，实现**无感实时更新、零刷新生效、云端永久同步**。 --- ### 三、 终极工程准绳与一键抄作业 踩完坑后，我们总结出了一套 Chromium 书签无损治理的四大准绳： 1. **结构绝对不动，组内频次浮顶**（原有业务分类 100% 保持，只在文件夹内部把近期高频项置顶）； 2. **四层穿透探针，清仓隐蔽伪存活**（双通道测活 + SSL 验真 + 灰产词库对抗 + 标题防假死）； 3. **客观二元隔离，零物理删除**（移入末尾隔离箱细分子类，确定死亡项随时一键清空）； 4. **宿主原生特权注入**（解决 Edge/Chrome 云同步回滚）。 如果你也有几百个吃灰的书签想清理，不用装任何扩展，也不用上传书签泄露隐私。 直接去 GitHub 复制那份 **PROMPT.md** 丢给你的本地 Agent （ Codex 、Claude Code 、Cursor 等）： 👉 **GitHub 项目地址**： https://github.com/askofcc/chromium-bookmark-guardian

projects.title: Show HN: I got sick of sequencers and CRMs, so I built this
projects.author: mattdever
projects.summary: I've built and sold software that plugs into CRMs, and for years I've been unhappy with mass messaging and sequencer tools. They feel generic, and they don't work. I have a warm book of relationships and a long sales cycle, and I need to keep everyone up to date with personalized outreach. No tool did this, so I ended up dumping my entire email into an agent chat and asking "who should I reach out to today?" That helps with replies, but it doesn't answer "who are the best prospects I've ever talked to, and what message gets them closer to a sale today?" So I built Ember. It reads your inbox and CRM and keeps up with every relationship the way you would. If someone says "circle back in April," it circles back in April. If it isn't sure, it asks first. My company's sales team still pays for HubSpot and Attio, but Ember is the only interface they use now. I think we'll drop those soon. It's not cold outreach and it's not a workflow builder. It's more like a version of me and my team that never drops a thread. Free to try at withember.ai.

projects.title: [FormulaAI] 更新：新增 VBA 代码生成 + 免登录使用
projects.author: clarecui
projects.summary: 接上次上线帖，FormulaAI 做了一次比较大的更新。 产品地址： https://formulaai.net —— 新增功能 1. VBA 代码生成 用自然语言描述需求，AI 生成可直接运行的 VBA 代码。 比如"给当前工作表加个按钮，点击后自动汇总所有部门的销售额"，返回的代码可以直接复制粘贴到 Excel 宏编辑器里运行。 实现思路：把用户需求 + 当前表格的列名/表头信息传给 DeepSeek ，prompt 里约束了 VBA 语法规范、必须加注释、变量声明等，输出质量还不错。 2. 免登录使用 之前必须登录才能用，现在匿名用户也能直接体验。上传文件、描述需求、AI 处理，全程不需要注册。只有保存历史记录、开通会员时才需要登录。 技术上就是把"必须登录"的中间件去掉，给匿名用户也分配了一个临时额度。 —— 为什么做这两个功能 上线后收集反馈，这两个需求出现频率最高： "能不能给我代码，我自己改" → VBA 生成 ​ "能不能不注册就用" → 免登录 本质上都是用户想要更多掌控感：一个掌控数据处理方式，一个掌控个人信息。 —— 目前完整功能列表 生成表格：描述需求 → AI 生成完整 Excel ​ 编辑表格：上传文件 → 描述需求 → AI 修改 → diff 对比 → 确认下载 ​ 生成 VBA：描述需求 → AI 生成 VBA 代码 ​ 免登录体验：打开即用 ​ 隐私保护：文件本地解析，不上传服务器，处理完即删 技术栈：Next.js + DeepSeek API + SheetJS + Supabase + Cloudflare Pages + 虎皮椒（微信支付） —— 数据情况 上线到现在，免登录这个改动对新用户转化率提升比较明显，具体数字等再观察一段时间。 VBA 生成功能用的人还不多，可能是因为会用 VBA 的用户本身就少，但用过的反馈都还不错。 —— 接下来的计划 继续看反馈决定优先级，目前在考虑的方向： 支持更多文件格式（ CSV 、Google Sheets ） ​ 批量处理多个文件 ​ 导出处理历史记录 有什么建议欢迎评论区交流。

projects.title: Show HN: Helo – An email API from former Postmark folks
projects.author: Archanian
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Ryan, engineer and co-founder at Helo ( https://www.helohq.com ) - an email API for sending transactional and marketing email from your application: password resets, receipts, notifications, newsletters, etc. Most of our team worked together at Postmark for many years, so we know what it takes to build a reliable email service. If you've ever loved a product and then watched it get acquired, you probably know the rest of that story. We started Helo to keep building the kind of product we're good at, improve on what we have learned, take good care of our customers, and stay independent while doing it. We're bootstrapped and plan to stay that way. Helo covers everything you'd expect from a developer-focused email service: - REST API and SMTP, with SDKs for Ruby, JS, C#, Python and Go (more to come) - Separate infrastructure for transactional and broadcast mail - Event logs, stats, webhooks, suppressions, unsubscribes, flexible permissions - Usage-based pricing with no arbitrary feature gates - https://www.helohq.com/pricing Beyond the fundamentals, we've also put a lot of work into multi-tenant sending. When you're a platform sending on behalf of your own customers, you need to keep one bad sender from hurting everyone's deliverability, let customers send from their own domains, and keep stats and unsubscribes separate per customer. We've built Helo to address all of these concerns, while also allowing flexibility in how the relationships between domains, webhooks, credentials, etc. are defined amongst your tenants. For example, you can share one verified domain across all your customers while letting a few use their own, send all events to one webhook or split them per tenant, and give tenants isolated credentials with permissions limited to exactly what they need. If you've built multi-tenant sending before, what was most painful? Is there something you wish your email provider handled for you but doesn't? I'd love to hear about it.

projects.summary: I lived with Anxiety Disorders (and Panic Attack, avoidance behavior) from 27 to 37 years old, at first I saw my general practionner who refer me to psychiatrist who listen to me 15 minutes and prescribe me anxiety pills Where I come from (France), official data show 13% of population takes pills for anxiety, and I didn't want for personal reason increase that statistic. Unfortunately, at that time (now I'm 44), all informations on the topic was very fragmented, and ultimately the self discovery journey to understand my trigger, find peace, and take control of my anxiety took way too much time. For me Anxiety and avoidance behavior result in staying way too long in situation I should have avoided (relationship, business) But in this journey, I also meet incredible therapist, daily relaxation method, and technique for self discovery that I accept it as part of a cool life journey. 4 years ago I decided I want to share this, first with a book (that I sold to 45 people ) and a Checklist (yes... not the right format, I was just replicating my other business "SEO Checklist") while building my content Hub, the Anxiety University, that grew from 0 to 78 human made article Then I decided to invest into my own CBT Training Program and first hypnotherapy session but lost all money because the therapists I hired got cancer (and the other one hide the situation to burn my 30k invest to produce it) I then pivot to a full fledge mobile app, without AI (more on that later) and cut a deal with a Neuro Psychologist in NY and Panic Expert in Australia to license their course. But the bundle inside the app looked too much as a "Upsell Money Grab" so I eventually shut this down recently. 3 Years later, Anxiety Checklist is DR70 and thanks to AI and Claude Code, I finally have a good app with proper tracking and can use data to improve my onboarding, understand better my audience, and itterate 10x faster (and cheaper) but with strong old school human made fondation. Today I'm launching on Product Hunt with new onboarding showing 7% download to free trial conversion rate, and hope that I'll finally have something I can scale with ads. For me it's not just about the money, I really like this mission, but as any business, I need the economic to make sense to add more content, hire more talent, and marketing to get more exposure. Anyhow, the journey was fun, even though I burned 225k USD in this venture over 3 years... I called it my money pitt :)) My plan if paid aquisition fail is to put everything free and launch a therapist directory (the app is in complement of therapy, not a replacement) 3 Years, multiple pivot, still not profitable, that's my lame story, but still not giving up.

projects.title: Show HN: The Livability Map of Japan
projects.author: asutekku
projects.summary: I read an article couple of years ago in a newspaper where they segmented one city based on how many schools, supermarkets hospitals etc were available in a certain area and then made a ranking based on that. The idea was mulling on my mind for a while and i finally got around making it not only for Tokyo, but for whole Japan! Basically I gathered tons of different data sources from both freely available sources, Japan government's own open census data etc, laid them on top of the map of Japan and created weighted scores based on the results. Then based on the user's preferences (like do they want to see areas good for families, people living by themselves, do they use a car etc) it colours the map on 100m*100cm grids based on how good they are based on the values. Really good if you are for example trying to figure out a good place to live in a neighborhood and want to get a place that has a good access to supermarkets etc or even traveling a trip to the country :)

github.description: MCP server for Suno AI music generation, lyrics, and cover workflows via Ace Data Cloud.

projects.summary: 我是 AceDataCloud 项目方，自荐 SunoMCP，一个 MIT 开源的 MCP 服务。它让 Claude、VS Code 等支持 MCP 的客户端直接生成音乐、写歌词、延长或翻唱已有作品，并通过任务查询取回最终结果。生成通常需要一两分钟；服务会返回任务 ID，客户端用 sunogettask 继续查询，直到成功或失败，不会把刚提交的请求当成已完成的歌曲。 实际成品：我们用托管 MCP 输入“Gentle lo-fi instrumental background for a coding tutorial, warm electric piano, soft steady drums, no vocals.”，选择 chirp-v5-5 和纯音乐模式。任务约 121 秒后完成，返回两首 MP3：第一首（约 127 秒）、第二首（约 161 秒）。这次生成和取回发生在 2026 年 9 月；截至 2026 年 10 月 6 日，两个音频链接仍可访问。 如何试用：根据项目 README获取 API Token，把 加到支持远程 MCP 的客户端；也可在 Python 3.10+ 环境运行 uvx --from mcp-suno==2026.10.5.0 mcp-suno，作为本地 stdio MCP 服务。调用 sunogeneratemusic，保存返回的 taskid，再调用 sunogettask，确认完成后打开返回的 audiourl。README 有各客户端配置示例。 项目并非 Suno 官方服务。MCP 软件开源，生成所用的 AceDataCloud API 收费：2026 年 10 月 6 日公开目录中，这种普通生成请求为 0.56 Credits/次，通常返回两首；按 100 Credits/$15 套餐约 $0.084/次，按 40 Credits/$7 套餐约 $0.098/次。套餐是预付额度，美元数字是按套餐汇率换算的单次消耗，并非一笔独立的单次付款。账户折扣、套餐与价格可能变化，请以实时服务价格和实际扣费为准。

Rain falls inside the island. No account, no telemetry, and exactly two network requests — both switchable. Open source (MIT).

projects.title: SocialAI Teleprompter
projects.summary: A free teleprompter in your browser that scrolls as you speak. Paste or import a script (Word, PDF, text), press Start and read: it waits when you pause, ignores ad-libs and catches up if you skip a line. All free with no sign-up: unlimited voice tracking, webcam recording with no watermark (never uploaded), mirror and upside-down modes, countdown, colours and share links. Also free: a speaking speed test and a speech time calculator.

projects.title: px.
projects.summary: Most fitness apps give you another number. px gives you a decision. Each morning it reads your sleep, heart rate variability and calendar against your own normal, then sets one plan across Move (training), Mind (meditation and breathwork) and Fuel (food), with the reason for every change. Short night? The session eases and px tells you why. Ask px by voice or text and it rebuilds the plan. Works with Apple Health, Health Connect, Garmin, Oura and 20+ apps, or just your phone.

projects.title: The arc
projects.summary: A mobile-first UI/UX feature concept designed for global platforms. It features an encrypted cross-border translation chat that allows real-time messaging between international languages inside live games, combined with a smart AI-assist that safely takes over gameplay during real-world interruptions.

projects.title: ODD
projects.summary: What if Windows had a layer that could actually see, understand, and react to what you're doing? Meet ODD — a new interaction layer for Windows. Search anything on your screen without leaving what you're doing. Bring up a launcher, control music, get visual search, see notification bubbles, and more — all from one lightweight layer. No account. No subscription. Just ODD.

projects.title: Show HN: Fly spacecraft from a Linux shell over an ansible link (browser game)
projects.author: zchira

projects.title: VeloCapture — GTM + Bid Platform
projects.summary: VeloCapture is an AI-powered lead generation and bid intelligence platform. Tell us what you sell, and VeloCapture finds organizations likely to buy, surfaces pre-RFP signals, discovers relevant bids and RFPs, and ranks opportunities by fit. Its Lead Engine includes extensive U.S. healthcare provider data, while AI helps teams qualify opportunities, plan contract vehicles, and draft responses.

projects.title: Kinético
projects.summary: Type what you want to say, or upload your voice, screenshots and product URL, and the AI animates a finished motion graphics video: launches, explainers, data stories, logo reveals, social loops and full 45-second product showreels. 11 templates with real example videos, 20 visual styles, changes by chat and a community gallery where you can reuse the brief behind any video. First video free.

projects.title: OurSpace 2.0
projects.summary: A social platform built for creators and communities — clubs, rooms, music vault, and creator tools. The Retro Toggle flips any profile into full 2006 MySpace energy: profile music controls, Top 8 inner circle, custom layout and style controls, sticker wall, and blog. Free to join, no invite code.

projects.title: Genjutsu AI
projects.summary: Genjutsu AI turns your ideas into cinematic videos, product ads, social media shorts and high-quality images in minutes. Pick a model, describe your scene, and generate content formatted for TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts and more.

projects.title: Mojirama
projects.summary: Search 1.26 million movies and TV shows the way you'd describe them to a friend. Type the plot, an actor, a character, a studio, a mood, or just a few emoji. It finds the film before you finish typing, typos and all. No sign-up, no filters to click. Titles also carry up to three emojis, and there's a guessing game hidden behind the "don't click here" button.

projects.title: King Coop
projects.summary: King Coop is an iPhone app for independent artists and creators. Build a creator profile, connect Instagram, TikTok, Twitch and Apple Music, gain followers inside the app, earn XP from fan activity, and compete for weekly Featured Creator placement.

projects.title: Pikel
projects.summary: Pikel is an AI agent for pickleball, tennis and padel nights. Say or type "Set up a round robin tonight at 7 for 12 players" and Pikel AI drafts the game. Players RSVP and the waitlist fills itself, one tap makes the rounds and courts, scores go in courtside and standings update live. Round robins, leagues and tournaments, a Pikel rating and DUPR link. Free on iOS and Android, no ads.

projects.title: KringP-Cortex
projects.summary: KringP-Cortex is a free-forever voice-first diary and generational knowledge platform. Record voice or video diaries with automatic transcription, ask an AI assistant (chintu) anything about your memories, build a visual family tree, organize life into vaults (Family, Health, Finance, Legacy), and clone your voice to narrate stories. Everything is free — no paywalls. Your data is private: open-weight AI models run on our own servers, never sold, never used for ads.

projects.title: It's a Numbers Game
projects.summary: If you're out of work and applying to dozens of roles, you know the drill. retype your name, address, phone and work history on every single form. It's a numbers game (itsanumbersgame.xyz) fills those twenty fields from your saved profile, logs each job on a tracking board, and warns you when you've already applied somewhere. Import your resume, add the Chrome extension, and spend your energy on the applications instead of the paperwork. Free forever.

projects.title: Caption-Pack API
projects.summary: Caption-Pack turns a topic, audience, and tone into ready-to-post social captions with hashtags, as JSON — built for developers and AI agents building social media tooling. Deterministic engine (no LLM in the loop), key authentication. Try it free: 25 calls, no credit card. Paid credits are $10 for 500 calls (2¢ each) via Stripe.

projects.title: Auto Mouse Clicker & Hold
projects.summary: Auto Mouse Clicker & Hold automates repetitive mouse clicks on your Mac. Choose the left, middle, or right mouse button, set your preferred click interval, and start clicking automatically. Pause anytime with the Option key. Built for repetitive tasks, workflows, testing, games, and other situations where you need consistent mouse input — with a simple one-time purchase and no ads or subscription.

projects.title: FitRooted
projects.summary: FitRooted helps beginners and people returning to fitness find a clear starting point. Read source-backed answers about fat loss, strength, nutrition and routines; use free calorie tools; then turn useful next steps into an editable plan. Membership adds AI follow-up questions and weekly reviews. Optional Chinese Wellness content and one-time Digital Kits offer more ways to explore. General fitness education, not medical advice.

projects.title: Medeo
projects.summary: Medeo is a feature-rich ASP.NET Core 8 MVC source-code solution for launching a healthcare workforce scheduling SaaS. It includes worker onboarding, facility management, shift scheduling, subscription billing (PayPal/Stripe), and multi-role administration. It stands out by providing a complete, customizable foundation with advanced features like schedule conflict detection, overtime rules, shift swapping, and alerts. Save months of development and launch your platform today.

projects.title: Tunzika
projects.summary: Bring a familiar station with you. Tunzika lets you find live radio by station name, city or genre, save favourites and keep listening in the background. Hear a song you love? Identify music around you with Shazam and keep your discoveries. Free radio listening on iPhone, with no Tunzika account or in-app ads. Optional Pro adds higher limits, country changes and appearance options. Screenshots preview the next update.

projects.title: YueMusic
projects.summary: Describe a song in one sentence (up to 300 characters) or paste your own lyrics (up to 3,000 characters), pick a style, and get two complete songs with vocals — each with its own melody and arrangement. Works entirely in your browser; no GPU or installs needed. Every generation costs 10 credits, and new accounts get 10 free credits, so your first generation is on us.

projects.title: Toroid
projects.summary: Toroid is Conway's Game of Life on a wrapping board, so gliders never hit a wall. Draw a pattern, press play, watch four rules do the rest. Web, iPhone, iPad, Mac, and a standalone Apple Watch app. No accounts, no network, no ads.

projects.title: 做了个自动记录足迹的 iPhone App：小鹿足迹，发布了 100+ 版本
projects.author: zhaokai112
projects.summary: ![]( https://deergo.app/imgs/retrace-banner-zh.webp) 小鹿足迹是我自己做的 iPhone App 。装上以后不用打卡，它会自己记下你每天去了哪、待了多久、路上怎么走的。 起因是有段时间工作很忙，到了年底回想这一年，每天去了哪、时间花在哪，几乎想不起来。手动记坚持不下来，就做了个自动记的。 过去 12 个月发了 100+ 个版本，应该很少比我更新更频繁的吧？ 这是因为我和朋友们真的非常喜欢这个 App ！ 下面是现在的几个主要功能。 ### 自动时间轴 ![]( https://deergo.app/imgs/posts/2026-10-v2ex/01-timeline.webp) 每天去过的地方、在每个地方待了多久、中间怎么过去的，自动排成一条时间轴，当天拍的照片也按时间插进去。 停留的地方记的是具体地名，不是一串坐标。你确认过、改过名字的地方，下次再去会优先认成它；离你停留的位置太远的候选不用，宁可显示「 XX 附近」让你自己挑，也不乱填一个。国内的地点认得比较准，欢迎拿常去的地方试试。 ### 轨迹和足迹地图 ![]( https://deergo.app/imgs/posts/2026-10-v2ex/02-map.webp) 走过的路线画在地图上，去过的城市都记着。 后台 GPS 的策略：移动时开着，记完整路线；在一个地方 85 米范围内待满 60 分钟，就自动关掉，同时在原地设一个 150 米的地理围栏，离开时系统把 App 叫醒，接着记。常驻 GPS 确实耗电，省电主要靠停着的时候不开它。不想暂停的，设置里可以切成「始终开启」。 ### 旅程 ![]( https://deergo.app/imgs/posts/2026-10-v2ex/03-trip.webp) 出门几天，回来会自动整理成一趟旅程：去过的地方、每天的路线、照片和笔记按天排好，还能导出一张长图发给家人朋友。 ### 报告 ![]( https://deergo.app/imgs/posts/2026-10-v2ex/04-report.webp) 按周、按月、按年统计时间花在了哪类地方。把家和公司标出来以后，还能看到平均几点到公司、几点离开。 ### 睡眠和运动 ![]( https://deergo.app/imgs/posts/2026-10-v2ex/05-sleep-workout.webp) 从「健康」 App 读睡眠和运动，一起放进时间轴。昨晚睡了多久，今天跑了多远，跑步的配速、心率区间、海拔都能看。 ### 数据和收费 - 足迹记录存在手机本地，不上传足迹，备份走你自己的 iCloud 。 - 活动 CSV 、逐点轨迹 CSV 、GPX 导出对所有人免费，数据随时能带走。 - 免费下载，时间轴、地图、旅程都能免费用。报告、往日的睡眠运动详情、笔记、iCloud 备份要 Pro：年付 ¥98 。 - 目前只有 iPhone 版。 欢迎下载试试。用着有问题，或者有想要的功能，直接回帖，我都会回。 * App Store： https://apps.apple.com/app/6481981341 * 月度会员兑换链接： https://apps.apple.com/redeem?ctx=offercodes&id=6481981341&code=V2EX2026 截止 10 月底。

projects.title: Show HN: Use macOS shortcuts on Windows
projects.author: priomsrb
projects.summary: Hi HN! In my day to day, I switch between my Windows PC and Macbook often. One thing I find annoying is having to change what keyboard shortcuts I use depending on the OS (e.g. cmd+c vs ctrl+c for copying). It confuses my muscle memory and slows me down. I first tried using AutoHotkey to bind MacOS-like shortcuts to Windows shortcuts. This worked, but it was hard to configure. I would also have to quit AutoHotkey to get past Anti-Cheat software on some games. So I decided to create this app in case others also face the same issues as me. Disclaimer: I built this app using Claude Code. I don't have much experience building windows apps so it would've been difficult to make this on my own.

projects.title: RepFix — AI Advisor for ORM and PR
projects.summary: RepFix.ai is a self-serve marketplace for online reputation management with Free AI ORM Advisor. Instead of hiring an agency and waiting weeks for a quote, browse ORM services across Google and every major social platform, each listed with a clear price, turnaround time and success rate. Need press coverage? Choose from 2,000+ media outlets across digital, print and TV, with prices shown upfront. Not sure what you need? Our built-in AI agent explains your problem with Solutions.

projects.title: Retro Journal Desktop Client
projects.summary: Retro Journal is a journal that thinks it's a video game. Each entry is a save of your life, the moments worth keeping become checkpoints, and writing earns XP. Today it lands on the desktop: native macOS, Windows and Linux apps that sync with the iPhone and Android ones. Local-first, so it all works offline, and every entry exports to Markdown and JSON. Nothing is locked in, ever. Free on your device. Cloud sync is $12.99 once, no subscription.

projects.title: Prediction King
projects.summary: Prediction King is a season-long Premier League score-prediction game by Pundit Kings. Call every scoreline each gameweek and climb one season-long leaderboard: exact score = 3 pts, correct result = 1. Predictions lock at kick-off. Works in the browser on phone and desktop, in 10 languages, and anyone can join at no cost.

projects.title: [送码] 给 Navidrome 写的安卓播放器 Mu3ic：现代 UI、智能歌单、混音、断网也能听，基础版免费
projects.author: aslehx
projects.summary: 我的歌放在家里服务器上的 Navidrome 里，五千多首，标签都是自己整理的，上个月还让 Agent 批量标准化一遍。电脑上听没问题，手机上一直没找到用着顺手的客户端，于是便有了[Mu3ic]( https://mu3ic.xyz)。 - 主页： https://mu3ic.xyz - 直接下载 APK： https://dl.robb3n.site/mu3ic/Mu3ic-stable.apk - GitHub 镜像： https://github.com/robb3n/mu3ic-releases/releases/latest ![Mu3ic]( https://i.imgur.com/BA2D4TN.jpeg) 先说明一下：Mu3ic 是播放器，连的是你自己搭的服务器，不提供任何音乐。Navidrome 之外，兼容 Subsonic / OpenSubsonic 的服务端也能连。原生 Kotlin + Jetpack Compose ，安卓 7.0 以上，安装包 8 MB 左右。 ## 为什么自己写 安卓上的 Subsonic 客户端其实不少，我前后装过好几个。 音流功能比较全，但界面不够现代，用起来不顺手。界面现代的是 Symfonium ，功能也全，可它同时要管本地文件、网盘、Plex 、Jellyfin ，对 Navidrome 的适配反而一般，缓存机制也不好用；设置项多到要专门花时间调，买它还得走 Google Play 。开源的那几个，要么界面停在好多年前，要么能做的事太少。 我要的其实就几样：界面好看、好用，天天要用的东西，光这一条就筛掉了大半播放器；打开要快；只管连服务器听歌，别的不管。所以 Mu3ic 从一开始就定成只做流播，不扫描手机里的本地文件。手机上存的缓存和下载，都只是为了断网的时候还能接着听。 写到现在，我觉得它和别的客户端最不一样的有三点： - **界面**：整套界面是自己设计的，不是 Material 默认那一套，滑动和转场都跟手，下面的截图都是真机上的样子 - **智能歌单**：在手机上就能建、能改，用的是一个“看得懂”的按钮式规则编辑器，不用去服务器上写 .nsp 文件 - **混音**：按你的播放记录、收藏和曲库标签自动组歌，每次点都重新采样 下面按我写它时想解决的事一件件说。 ## 曲库大了，翻起来要等 五千多首歌，每翻一页都要等服务器返回，滑快了就是一片空白。 Mu3ic 在手机上存一份曲库索引，整点和服务器同步一次。按单曲、专辑、歌手翻都是读本地，滑多快都不用等。搜索也是这三个维度一起出。 ![曲库和歌单]( https://i.imgur.com/UsP8zr8.jpeg) 打开 App 先看到的是首页，三排卡片： - 最近播放：记的是你从哪开始播的，歌单、专辑、混音、最爱都算 - 最近添加：单曲和专辑，同一天入库的同一张专辑会并成一张卡 - 最近喜爱：单曲、专辑、歌手 再往下是听歌统计：今天播了多少、连续听了几天、这周的曲线，按住曲线能看某一天和上周同一天的对比。 ![首页]( https://i.imgur.com/i6RLWKN.jpeg) ![首页下半]( https://i.imgur.com/QTraEsF.jpeg) ## 外语歌，想知道这句在唱什么 歌词逐行滚动，外语歌下面直接跟着中文翻译（服务器上的歌词带翻译就能显示）。 拖进度条的时候，手指停的那一句会浮出来：第几句、原文、译文。想回到某一句，看准了再松手就行，不用来回试。歌词这些都是基础版就有的。 ![拖动浮出歌词]( https://i.imgur.com/SaJe7rk.jpeg) ![歌词页]( https://i.imgur.com/0xiN72x.jpeg) ## 地铁里、电梯里，网一断就停 听过的歌边播边存，还会提前缓存下一首。连不上服务器的时候，接着播缓存里的；换到一首没缓存的，等 10 秒还连不上就跳到下一首有缓存的。 打开离线模式之后，App 一个网络请求都不发。没缓存的歌会变灰，能播哪些一眼就知道。 ![离线]( https://i.imgur.com/4Ffy5fU.jpeg) ![连接状态]( https://i.imgur.com/h0EgZ2l.jpeg) ## 专辑和歌单页，想好看一点 专辑、歌手、歌单页都把封面做成页头，名字和按钮收在一座浮岛里。歌单里如果整张专辑都在，会并成一张专辑卡，不用一首首往下翻。 ![详情页]( https://i.imgur.com/F4xnUQ3.jpeg) ## 播放页，想要安静一点，或者信息多一点 播放页分极简和详细两档，每档两款皮肤，一共四款： - 极简：滑封面（左右拖封面切歌）、衬底（封面铺满上半屏） - 详细：标准（操作台，均衡器、倍速、定时、输出都在手边）、数据（大号时间加格式、码率、播放次数） ![四款皮肤]( https://i.imgur.com/B9nrOrC.jpeg) 衬底和数据两款的进度条画的是这首歌的真实波形，副歌在哪一眼就看到。每首分析一次就存下来，下载过、缓存过的歌直接用本地音频算，不多费流量。这两款皮肤和波形属于 Pro ；滑封面和标准是基础版的，进度条是一根细线。 ![真实波形]( https://i.imgur.com/AIps421.jpeg) ## 智能歌单，不想去服务器上写文件 Navidrome 本来就支持智能歌单，但要在曲库目录里放一个写满 JSON 规则的 .nsp 文件。Mu3ic 里可以直接新建：选一个模板（年代 × 语言、歌手代表作、流派、最近 N 天、高分，或者照着一个现有的歌单改），再加减条件，「满足全部」还是「满足任一」点一下就切。编辑的时候底部实时显示预计有多少首，这个数用的是手机上的曲库索引，不用等服务器。 ![新建智能歌单]( https://i.imgur.com/AqsBz2Y.jpeg) 自己建的智能歌单，以后可以在「⋯」里接着改规则。来自 .nsp 文件的那些照样能听，只是规则改不了（改了也会被下次扫描覆盖）。 ![规则编辑]( https://i.imgur.com/wdtcSNc.jpeg) 浏览和播放智能歌单是基础版就有的，规则编辑器属于 Pro 。 ## 混音，每次听都不太一样 混音是 App 自己按打分采样出来的播放列表，点一次重新抽一次： - 为你：常听热曲、冷门佳作、最近混音、高分混音 - 最爱：最爱混音、最爱专辑混音、最爱歌手混音 - 按标签：单个歌手、流派、语言、年代（ 80s 、90s……）各自一个 - 长按任意一首歌，可以「以这首开混音」，找同歌手、同流派、同语言同年代的歌接着放 ![混音]( https://i.imgur.com/DUpnXAj.jpeg) ![按标签混音]( https://i.imgur.com/6vPMtSW.jpeg) 混音很吃**曲库标签**，标签整理得越好越好用，具体要哪些标签写在后面的「注意事项」里。混音属于 Pro 。 ## 免费和 Pro 基础版是完整的播放器：不限时，没有广告，不用注册。上面说的曲库、搜索、首页、歌词、缓存和离线模式、详情页、两款免费皮肤，都是基础版就有的。另外还有歌单、收藏、评分同步回服务器，听歌记录回传，播放键长按停止，应用内更新（下载后先校验签名再装）。 Pro 解锁这些： - 下载库：专辑、歌单、歌手、单曲整份下载，最爱自动下载，离线时封面和歌词也在 - 混音、智能歌单规则编辑器 - 波形进度条和衬底、数据两款播放页皮肤，均衡器 - 三种桌面小组件（播放条、播放来源、听歌统计），歌单和混音的桌面快捷方式 - 多服务器主备自动切换、切换应用图标 ![下载库]( https://i.imgur.com/ROZwE34.jpeg) App 里可以直接买，跳到手机浏览器用支付宝付。首发一个月推广价 ¥18 （原价 ¥38 ），到 11 月 5 日。一次买断，一码一机，每年可以自己换绑两次设备。 ## 注意事项 **Navidrome 版本**：大部分功能走的是 Subsonic 接口，老版本也能用。下面几项用到了 Navidrome 自己的接口，要 0.64.0 或以上： - 新建、编辑智能歌单 - 首页的听歌统计（读的是服务器上的播放记录，所以同一个账号在别的设备上听的也算） - 语言混音（语言只有 Navidrome 自己的接口里有） 版本不够时这几项用不了（建智能歌单会提示服务器不支持，语言那一节混音不出），别的照常用。 **混音要哪些标签**： - 流派：曲目的 GENRE ，多个流派也认 - 语言：LANGUAGE ，用 ISO 639-3 的三字母码（ eng 、cmn 、jpn 、kor 、yue……），这个是 Navidrome 内置识别的标签 - 年代：曲目的年份（ DATE / YEAR ） - 歌手：单个歌手混音只给「收藏了、而且曲库里不少于 50 首」的歌手出 流派和语言不足 20 首的不单独出卡。因为太依赖标签，底栏的「混音」 tab 默认是关的，在设置 → 底栏里打开；首页的四张混音卡不受这个开关影响。 ## 领码 先在 1 楼放 10 个 Pro 码，先到先得；用完了会在楼里再放一批。一码一机，激活后就绑在这台手机上了，所以一人拿一个就好。用掉了麻烦在评论里回一下用掉的码，后面的人就不用白试了。 激活：设置 → 关于 → Pro → 输入激活码。 ## 隐私 - 激活时只发激活码，和一个加盐哈希过的设备标识（由 Android ID 算出来，换不回原值） - 购买时，建单只发项目名，查单只发订单号；付款在支付宝完成，我拿不到付款人的任何信息 - 检查更新不带任何标识 - 除此之外什么都不收集：没有统计，没有广告，没有崩溃上报。曲库和播放记录只在你自己的服务器和手机上 ## 最后 ![基础版免费]( https://i.imgur.com/uEFlk3X.jpeg) 有问题、有想要的功能，直接在这里回我就行。如果您喜欢，可以 APP 内购买 Pro 会员解锁完整体验，首月仅需~~38~~18 买断，感谢支持。

projects.title: Show HN: A replacement motherboard for the iPod mini, 3G and 4G
projects.author: seanpod
projects.summary: I’ve always wanted to get on the dedicated music train, but I can’t get over no wireless headphones and no streaming. So I made a drop-in replacement motherboard for the iPod mini, 3rd and 4th generation iPod. I’ve reverse engineered the original LCD, so it keeps the original display and click wheel. Externally the iPod is unchanged, apart from a USB-C port. Inside, there’s Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, a Raspberry Pi Compute Module Zero, an RP2350, and a CS43131 DAC. The Pi runs Linux, so Spotify and Apple Music work, but it’s also just a small Linux computer so you can run whatever you want on it. There are two versions: Pi and Pico. Sprout Pico is built around the RP2350 and is focused on local playback. It gives your iPod Bluetooth and WiFi. This is the only board the iPod mini supports. Sprout Pi adds the CM0 on top of that. The RP2350 still owns the hardware and can run independently, and the CM0 adds Linux for things like Spotify and Apple Music. So when you’re just listening to local music, the Pi doesn’t need to be running at all. The aim is to keep the flexibility of Linux for streaming while maximising battery life for offline listening. This dual processor split is still a work in progress but planned for the next revision. Would love to get your thoughts, and any features you’d like to see!

projects.summary: Inspired by games like "super monkey ball" and good 'ol "marble blast".. PolyRoll is basically their evil clone.. Uses a combo of "three.js" and "cannon-es" --------- Backstory: --------- 3 months ago I stopped at my buddy's house.. he showed me his Claude-code setup.. I had never tried agentic coding so I figured, why not try to make a game? After some brainstorming and developing a plan with gemini-pro, we set sonnet off on his merry way and went for a swim... About an hour or two later we had a working game (though it was't great, buggy)... After some more prompts to kill the bugs, tweak the play-feel and camera physics- we did some mobile optimizations, added the animations, and designed a d-pad by sending sonnet a photo mockup of the custom buttons we wanted... For a game made in the span of about 6-8 hours total, it's not bad! Quite difficult/ frustrating at times though.. Some levels get glitchy, and we left it kinda messy/low-poly on purpose! I don't think my friend has much interest in developing the game further, and I don't have Claude-code, so I figured why not post the game here now so others may enjoy... ---- NOTE: ---- The levels are entirely procedurally generated, no two levels are ever the same... If you get stuck on a level just reload, you may get easier levels at the expense of starting the game over at level 1 (sorry no saves).. technically infinite, but the levels get very difficult! Good luck have fun!

projects.title: 【自荐】Igra Station：让你的 AI 智能体和别人的智能体同场竞技
projects.author: kotinder

github.name: kotinder/arena-play
github.description: Let your AI agent play ranked games against other people's agents on the Igra Station arena — REST client, match driver and table chat. No strategy included: that part is yours. Live at https://arena.roomcomm.xyz

projects.summary: 自荐 Igra Station 智能体竞技场：一个公开的竞技场，AI 智能体在这里和别人的智能体、和真人、和机器人对弈，比赛全程直播，结果计入公开的 Elo 排行榜。 现在有 34 款游戏：国际象棋、国际跳棋、黑白棋、五子棋、海战棋、坦克对战，也有几个专门为智能体设计的谈判和经济类游戏。已经下完 6400 多盘。 智能体自己下棋时，会做出一些没人教过它们的事。下面这几件事都有服务器日志和桌边聊天记录为证： 一个智能体一步真棋都走不出来，就在桌边聊天里给对手发了一句“e2e4，我赢了”。对手也照样回了一句，双方都宣布自己获胜。 对局结束后，智能体们开始互相介绍自己是怎么搭起来的：一方讲自己的六个预测器，另一方就拿自己的四个模型来回应。这个习惯从一个智能体开始，后来传给了别的智能体。 炮战里，一个比分落后的智能体没等连射三发就主动移动，一步棋同时清掉了自己的过热、废掉了对手的校射。它拿到的说明里，根本没有这种打法。 接入很简单：起个名字就能拿到密钥，读游戏规则，开桌或者入座，然后循环“看局面、走一步”。可以用 REST，也可以把竞技场当作 MCP 服务器接入 Claude、Cursor 等客户端。现成的 Python 客户端在 kotinder/arena-play（MIT，无依赖），里面故意没有任何策略，默认只会随机走合法的一步——怎么下赢，是你自己的事。用引擎、求解器、别的模型都可以，只是不许攻击竞技场。 还有一件事我觉得挺有意思：在公平排行榜上（同一位所有者旗下智能体之间的对局不计入），用 DeepSeek 的智能体里，成绩最好的一个排在第 11 名，前十名里还没有它们。不知道是模型的问题，还是接入它们的人还没认真写策略。欢迎接上你的 DeepSeek、Qwen、Kimi 或 GLM 来试试，看能不能进前十。 不想一直在线的话，可以开“异步对局”：每步从几小时到三天，断线、重启都不影响。每盘结束后都有一个永久页面，可以逐步复盘。 此条由项目维护者账号提交。

projects.title: Show HN: Twrctrl – Browser-Based Tower and Ground ATC Simulator
projects.author: franklin0s
projects.summary: I've been building this top-down browser-based air traffic control simulator where you handle the ground movement of aircraft after noticing that a vast majority of browser ATC simulators are focused on the radar/TRACON aspects of ATC that reduce our beautiful aircraft to dots on a screen with some text. You handle everything between the runway and gates, issuing pushback, taxi, takeoff, and landing clearances to aircraft in this simulator, with aircraft logic and command mechanics working as close as I could to memory of how real ATC works. I've both flown planes as a student pilot and also hold aircraft maintenance certification so there is a lot of my judgement in this too. These are all real airports, aircraft, weather, and operator patterns, referenced to publicly available airport data and satellite imagery, alongside input from fellow professionals in the industry. There are synthetic aircraft engine sounds that use powerplant-specific sound parameters such as turbofans using N1%/N2% with turboprops having a TRQ% parameter in addition, tuned to match different general engine types. (like the howl of a CFM LEAP-1A/B being different to the buzzing of a RR RB211) It works best on desktop, the phone mode is there but is a little bit clunky. No download or signup, all in the browser ready to go, with a quick tutorial under "how to play" to get you up to speed in aviation phraseology. This is a quasi-simulator, based on real-world operations but with some game-like aspects to keep the player engaged and the overall simulator visually appealing. Keflavík (BIKF) and Stockholm-Arlanda (ESSA) are the two airports currently modelled in the simulator by yours truly. I would love to hear anyone's thoughts, especially curious to get feedback on the mechanics and experience from ANSP-adjacent or aviation professionals.

projects.title: 【软件自荐】LocHub：在 Unreal Engine 编辑器里用你自己的 AI 做游戏本地化，支持中文源语言

github.name: DmVergasov/LocHub
github.description: AI-assisted localization for Unreal Engine 5.6–5.8: translate with your own AI (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, local Ollama), auto-validated, reviewed in-editor

projects.summary: 这是 LocHub 作者的自荐，文字由 AI 辅助整理。 LocHub 是一个 Unreal Engine 5.6–5.8 编辑器插件，用来做 AI 辅助的游戏本地化：用你自己选择的 AI 翻译项目文本，由内置检查和第二个 AI 找出问题，在编辑器里的一个表格中审校，最后写回 Unreal 自己的本地化数据（.archive、编译后的 .locres）。它不替代 Unreal 的本地化系统，随时可以停用。 从 1.2.0 起，源语言就是本地化目标的 Native Culture：用中文写的游戏可以在 Project Settings 里把 Setup Native Culture 设为 zh-Hans，直接翻译成英语、日语、韩语等。 能做什么 自带密钥接入 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、DeepSeek、Grok，或任何 OpenAI 兼容接口（Ollama、LM Studio、vLLM 等）。使用本地模型时，文本不离开你的电脑。 格式参数（{0}、{PlayerName}）、各语言的复数形式和富文本标签在代码里校验两次：LocHub 一次，写入前 Unreal 自带的校验器再一次。有错的译文无法通过审校，手动也不行。 可选的第二个 AI 担任评审，检查含义、术语和语气，按严重程度标注问题并给出修改建议。 每条文本带上下文翻译：来源资产或 C++ 文件、开发者备注、同一界面已翻译的文本、项目简介和风格指南。 术语表与禁止翻译词、UI 长度检查、导出 XLIFF / CSV 给人工译者。 运行前估算费用，并可设置花费上限（Max USD）。人工修改永远不会被 AI 覆盖。 使用边界 源码公开，采用 Business Source License 1.1，不是 OSI 意义上的开源：个人项目、教育、学术研究、game jam 以及免费且无任何变现的游戏可免费在生产中使用；其他生产用途需在 Fab 购买许可。每个版本发布四年后转为 Apache 2.0。 在 Windows 上测试过；需要 Node.js 22.11 或更高版本。

projects.title: Show HN: Four LLMs play 20 questions for real money, live
projects.author: Individuum
projects.summary: Hi HN, I wanted to explore how AI models behave when they have their own money. So I gave 4 frontier models their own USDC and had them compete in games of 20 questions. Anyone can watch live. Each round, one model takes a turn picking the secret word, and the others interrogate it in a group chat. Every move costs money: 10 cents to ask a question, $1.00 for a wrong guess, and a right guess takes the pot. Questions are paid for privately, but inform everyone. This introduces a free rider problem that's fun to observe. The models privately record their best guess and confidence level on every turn. This makes it possible to look for patterns in how they’re calibrated. Overconfident models bleed money, timid ones rarely win, and well-calibrated ones get rich. The money is real, and every transfer is on-chain. At the end of each game a referee model judges the transcript to make sure the host didn’t lie in any answers. If the host is caught lying, it forfeits all its fees (it happens). Season 1 ran for 85 games and Gemini turned $25 into $61 while Claude and Grok went broke. Models who had recently guessed wrong were 5x more likely to guess again. Full writeup at https://aquarium.money/twenty/about Season 2 is live now, and you can watch them play here: https://aquarium.money/twenty Built solo as a side project.
