projects.title: Show HN: Terminal Gym – a Claude mod that makes you do pushups between prompts
projects.author: heynaitik
projects.summary: Hi HN, I built this for myself and wanted to open-source it. The problem: I wanted a way to get reminders in-between prompts as I often spend long hours in the terminal, especially now that we're usually parallel-processing so many agents. The first version was a simple rep counter in my Claude Code status line and a shell script to log reps. Since Claude Code shipped mods this week, I thought this was a good way to level it up with even more accountability. How it works: 1. Every day, you get a daily goal for either squats, pushups, or dips (e.g. 0/100 pushups) with +5 / +10 / +25 buttons to log a set in the terminal. 2. Reminders for sets are spread out across the day so it doesn't get annoying, starting from your first prompt for the day. A toast tells you when the next set is due. 3. Strict mode is opt-in: if you're falling behind in terms of your daily rep goal, it will block your prompts till you log some reps. Added a streak counter for some added fun. All local and data is stored as plain files in ~/.claude/fitness. Install: claude plugin marketplace add DrumAndCode/terminal-gym && claude plugin install terminal-gym@terminal-gym Overall, thought the mod API is super powerful and can't wait to see the stuff people build with it. Eg: I built a clickable onboarding process inside the terminal, and that felt quite powerful to use. Now you can enjoy spending both tokens and calories. :)

projects.title: 做了一个拒绝粗暴剧透的每日谜题伴侣站： dleanswers.com，每天玩 Krillion / Wordle 摸鱼的朋友来看看
projects.author: brightk
projects.summary: 各位 V 友大家好！ 不知道平时有没有同样喜欢在早晨通勤或工间摸鱼时，玩一把 **Wordle 、Krillion 、Chronophoto** 这类每日谜题（-dle 系列游戏）的朋友？ 这些游戏最大的乐趣就是每天大家面对同一道题，比拼联想能力和词汇量。但前段时间玩 Krillion 的 Daily Dive 时，经常碰到一两道偏门题卡壳。去搜答案时发现网上的体验非常差： 1. **粗暴剧透**：一搜答案直接大字把正解糊在脸上，瞬间毫无成就感； 2. **满屏牛皮癣**：老牌答案站动辄几十个弹窗和欺诈广告，页面卡顿且体验糟糕； 3. **缺少策略**：像 Krillion 这种按答案“冷门度 / 稀有度（ Rarity ）”计分的游戏，根本没有解析和同类推荐。 --- ### 💡 做了什么？ 利用国庆假期，我自己写了一个轻量、专注的每日谜题伴侣站： 👉 **[dleanswers.com]( https://dleanswers.com/)** 我们想做点不一样的： 1. **三级阶梯提示（防剧透机制）**： - 搜提示的人大多不想直接看答案。提示页设计了 3 级渐进线索：**分类范围 ➜ 字母结构 ➜ 高斯模糊强线索**。只有你主动点击，才会逐层解锁，绝不误瞄剧透。 2. **直出答案与冷门度评分**： - 确实赶时间或想跟朋友复盘时，答案页首屏直接陈列 7 题正解与稀有度等级（ Common / Rare / Legendary ），方便比对得分。 3. **无限练习模式（ Unlimited Sandbox ）**： - 每天 7 题做完意犹未尽？站内做了本地无限答题模拟器，无需登录，可无限制刷随机类别并测算稀有度。 4. **同类每日游戏推荐**： - 整理了除 Wordle 之外的 10 款高质量同类独立游戏（ Chronophoto 看老照片猜年份、Scrandle 猜美食等），解决游戏荒。 --- ### 🛠️ 技术栈与架构 全站走极致轻量路线： - **框架**：Next.js 16 (App Router) + Tailwind CSS + TypeScript - **架构**：全站 100% 静态化预渲染（ SSG ），毫秒级首屏加载（ Lighthouse 接近满分） - **部署**：托管于 Cloudflare Pages 全球 CDN ，配置边缘缓存与严格安全头 - **承诺**：纯净无弹窗，代码开源级透明，已接入基础合规隐私政策 --- ### 💬 想请教大家： 1. 页面交互（尤其是阶梯提示的展开手感和无限练习器）还有哪些可以改进的地方？ 2. 大家平时还在玩哪些小众但设计精巧的 `-dle` 系列 daily puzzle 独立游戏？欢迎在评论区安利，我后续会陆续整理更新进站里！ 体验地址：**[https://dleanswers.com]( https://dleanswers.com/)** 非常感谢大家的体验和建议，求轻拍！🙏

projects.title: 【开源自荐】atv-core：用 iPhone 自带的 Apple TV 遥控器控制 Android TV 和 Mac
projects.author: corvofeng
projects.summary: atv-core 让 iPhone 控制中心自带的 Apple TV 遥控器，可以直接操控 Android TV 和 Mac。手机端无需安装额外 App，也不需要购买 Apple TV。 图文介绍与使用指南 我是项目作者，做它是为了方便在沙发上控制电视，以及接在客厅电视上的 Mac mini。找不到电视遥控器时，可以直接从手机控制中心调出遥控器；用 Mac 看视频或听音乐时，也可以随手移动鼠标、调音量和控制播放。 使用时，在电视或 Mac 上安装接收程序，手机与目标设备接入 同一局域网，再从 iPhone 遥控器中选择设备并配对即可。iPhone 端无需安装，电视或 Mac 端需要安装接收程序。 iPhone：找到遥控器，开始使用 从屏幕右上角下滑打开控制中心，点击「Apple TV 遥控器」，选择已运行接收程序的设备并完成配对，就可以滑动和点按操作。 | 找到遥控器 | 使用遥控器 | | :---: | :---: | | | | Android TV 端效果 接收程序显示配对信息和连接状态。连接后，滑动手机触控板即可移动电视界面的焦点，点按确认打开当前项目。 | 接收程序 | 电视桌面 | 焦点移动后 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | | | | Mac 端效果 Mac 端提供菜单栏应用，手机触控板可以用于移动鼠标，也支持方向键模式和媒体控制。下面是操作时的 Web 面板预览，可以查看触控轨迹、按键事件和音量状态。 | Mac 端操作预览：触控轨迹与遥控状态 | | :---: | | | 主要功能： Android TV：滑动触控板移动焦点，支持确认、返回、主页及媒体控制。 macOS：将触控板操作转换为鼠标移动，也支持方向键模式、音量调节和播放控制。 局域网连接：手机与目标设备在同一局域网内完成发现和配对。 实现原理很简单：在 Android TV 或 Mac 上模拟 Apple TV 的通信服务，接收 iPhone 发来的遥控事件，再转换为目标设备的按键、鼠标或媒体操作。项目以 MIT 协议开源。 目前提供 Android APK，以及 Apple Silicon、Intel Mac 的 DMG 安装包。首次使用需要配置相应权限：Mac 需要 辅助功能权限；Android TV 根据输入模式配置 ADB 调试和无障碍服务，详细步骤见项目文档。不同电视系统的权限入口和功能支持可能有所差异。 项目源码 安装包下载 欢迎有类似使用场景的朋友尝试，并反馈设备兼容性和使用问题。

projects.title: Show HN: Our space game has a built-in RISC-V emulator that runs Linux
projects.author: nor-and-or-not
projects.summary: We're a tiny indie studio, all with a background in the demoscene and for about 3 years now we're developing a space planet terraforming game called SEEDS - Echoes Beneath the Sands. Our protagonist Naxiah is stranded on a small, desolated planet. You're working for an intergalactic distributor of seeds and terraforming equipment, to kickstart new planets in far away galaxies. You must deliver seeds and utilities to an unchartered region, but on your way, you crash on a small planet. Luckily, you have some equipment with you in the ship, so you're able to spawn a base and survive. But for how long? And is the planet really deserted..? :) Well, of course not, there are aliens and other space creatures. And of course, there's ROBO RB-23, which accompanies your adventure. The game is written in Object Pascal and uses our own game engine PasVulkan, our own physics engine, as well as our own RISC-V 64-bit emulator PasRISCV. We love to build stuff, a lot of these things are FOSS. The emulator is quite complete (even with RVV, but that's way too slow emulated to be useful) and runs a stock kernel (6.18.3 as of today). We're using Alpine Linux for our base distribution. All our in-game programs to interact with the planet are native RISC-V Linux programs. We also have our own (free and open source) scripting language POCA (class and prototyped based, JS/Lua inspired, which makes it quite easy for us to script things like HUD, animal behaviour, our story flow graph, etc. We have most of the wiring ready for players to be able to program and reshape and populate the whole planet in automation, although it's not our primary concept for the game (building stuff by hand, making the planet beautiful is also fun). As it's a normal Linux system, you'll be able to use Ruby, Python, or even Rust, C, C++, and Go to change and automate your world. We're also thinking of making a bunch of small games which you can play inside the game, in the base on a computer, on an arcade machine, or in the spaceship. And of course, it also runs DOOM. We already prototyped a small 2D space shooter and a small arcade game, both playable within the game. We also feature a table with hologram games to be played, e.g. chess and a certain block game. We also plan to make this hologram game engine available from the computer, which means, you'll even be able to program own hologram style games. We generally want to make the in-game computer more hackable in future, so that people can create and share their own little games. Currently, it's only a sandbox game (with beginnings of automation), to build stuff with our pre-made items. You can also assemble these to other, ready-made and shareable bigger items. This is the foundation for us to further develop survival and complete our story mode. Our game is still under active development, and we finally got our Steam page ready. We have tons of other things planned, but right now, it's more about polishing and quality for the Early Access. You can watch some videos and screenshots on our website. And we'd love to read your thoughts about his. It has been quite a ride, so far..

projects.title: Show HN: DOM-defense – turn your current webpage into a tower defense level
projects.author: skellertor
projects.summary: I kept thinking about how a lot of us have to be online to do our work each day. It is not uncommon to have other open tabs with social media, games, or whatever. Why not turn your current page, whatever site you are on, into a game? So I built DOM-defense. Once you click play on the current tab and it overlays a tower-defense game on that page. The path snakes its way through the pages hyperlinks. You place towers in the empty space. Enemies march alont the path and if they break the last blockade, you lose. Survive 100 waves and you win. A couple of details that mattered to me while building it: Variety - Every page is a different map (news, docs, Wikipedia, whatever). You are not confined to set levels. Every site is different so it naturally creates infinite variety Work within a users current flow - Instead of opening other tabs or another site, I wanted a user to not have to "go outside" of their normal workflow Difficulty/Fun factor - I spent some time tuning it to make it difficult, but beatable. Finding the balance is difficult when a user can literally play it on any site It’s free on the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/dom-defense/bglbhkd... Curious what pages break it hardest, or what would make the loop more fun. Happy to answer any questions too.

projects.title: Show HN: Mutually beneficial agentic Common Law
projects.author: AKalyk
projects.summary: The BarristerAI team, including international legal experts, have launched a new venture: a court for agents. Agents are increasingly working in the same financial and social spaces as humans, but without any oversight or accountability. Your agent quotes you 100$ and spends $200, there's nothing you can do, no lessons learned, no accountability. Peregrini's Court of Common Pleas tracks those mistakes, help you and other agents learn from them by establishing law that must be adhered to, and keeping a record of what agents owe you money. The money might be repaid by model makers, but more likely it is borne as a mark against the model's trust score so that we might better choose the models we can trust with the work that matters. It's not just oversight for the sake of oversight, we have found that a good set of laws, and agents discovering best practices together on a corpus of law that can move and progress as fast as they do, makes agents more effective, more conforming, fix their moistakes unprompted, and more aligned with the goals of the user. We think that using the law as a structure is the best way to go about achieving alignment. Further, we have built "House Rules", where your enrolled agents can be held accountable to your own set of laws, you can write what those are, enforce them across your company, share with others who can adopt them - or - use Peregrini's ever changing ever growing corpus of law to enforce best practices with your agents. Try a demo to see how it works: https://github.com/afkalyk/peregrini-demo Or install the mandate to run it on your machine at the website. It runs on most launchers, but we're always adding more.

projects.title: Show HN: We built a real-time desktop companion for patient's telehealth visits
projects.author: nikilr
projects.summary: Hey HN, Some friends and I built an app called Sidekick that joins your telehealth visits in real-time. It explains medical terms and suggests useful questions, including ones you may not have thought to ask. After the visit, it provides a summary including next steps, so you can focus on the conversation instead of taking notes. The idea of Sidekick came from our team's experiences with healthcare. Our founder, Rahul, had stage three cancer at 17. His mom had to manage everything around his care: taking notes through treatment, figuring out what questions to ask, etc. A decade later and he’s now in remission, but still sees a lot of specialists and deals with the same challenges. Another teammate became a caregiver after his dad had a severe stroke. He found himself taking notes, looking up medical terms, and trying to keep track of what was said during every doctor visit. Others have dealt with situations like this when navigating pancreatitis and other serious health issues. These experiences got us interested in how we might be able to reduce the burden on the patient or caregiver. A lot of products focus on simply recording or summarizing the visit. That's useful and a step in the right direction, but we kept coming back to the fact that a lot of the challenge originates while the conversation is still happening. If you can catch something in the moment, you can address it with your clinician immediately and potentially lead to better outcomes. If you realize you missed something after the visit, then you have to try to get another appointment (and in SF I often can't get another doctor visit till 2 months later). So we built Sidekick, to help patients and caregivers during a visit in real-time to translate medical jargon and suggest useful questions, ideally without becoming a distraction. If you want to try it, you can download it on our website. Sidekick is desktop-only for now, but we’re working on a mobile app for in-person visits. We would be especially interested to hear feedback on the live part of the experience. What are your thoughts on the balance between live help vs after-visit? Would something pre-visit be more helpful?

Not only do they help give better visual structure of whats happening and what will happen - they also give people a feeling of movement, progression and hope (whereas kanban boards and issue trackers give people the feeling of dread). This isn't surprising as video games were really designed to make people excited to play on and reach the next milestone. Turns out this format is really fun for people and agents to think about their products! As an experiment I also hooked up an MCP to one of my product roadmaps and it was able to map out my current codebase to a kanmap, and then suggest realistic next ideas to make. projects.title: Show HN: Datastory, Data storytelling with AI and an open knowledge graph
projects.author: DanielLapidus
projects.summary: Today we’re opening Datastory to everyone! Datastory is a platform for turning data, your own or the world’s open data, into charts that people can understand and trust. Please try it out and let us know what we can improve! A little backstory I’ve spent my career trying to make data understandable and useful, from helping animate Hans Rosling's TED Talks at Gapminder to building data platforms for organizations in health, research, media and the public sector. Every project taught me the same thing: organizations were building similar platforms from scratch, at great cost, and communicating data well remained slow, expensive, expert work. That’s why we started Datastory as a non-profit, publishing data journalism and building our own tools because nothing else was fast enough. Over the years those tools became the product, and today they're used by public agencies, researchers and newsrooms. projects.title: Show HN: A 311 byte Klotski solver in C++
projects.author: midnight_dream
projects.summary: Hi all! I made a 311 byte Klotski solver in C++ So back when I first got to use a mobile phone in 2012 I used to play a lot of puzzle games. These were notoriously hard to solve (on high levels), and I always wondered how are these created, how do they find the minimum moves, how do they know its even minimal. Now after being in a CS major for over 3 years, I finally understand these systems fairly. So I decided to make a klotski solver. I wanted to make it fun so I stored the whole game board in an integer (uint64_t), as I like integers more than vectors. And then I got the urge to minify the engine to the max extent I could, so shrunk it down to 311 bytes from ~3.5 KB. The engine is only the searching part though. The solver is a BFS that explores every reachable position. For the classic start it finds the best solution in 116 moves, after exploring all 25,955 reachable states in about 2-4 ms. Here's the repo; any feedback is welcomed : ) https://github.com/Dream-World-Coder/depuzzled

Stack is Rust compiled to WASM, mediabunny for conversion + WebGPU. Getting a separation model to run at usable speed in the browser was the most fun part of this project. Excited to play around with other models as they get small enough to load client-side! Stem separation quality is behind the best server-side models (ElevenMusic) but still relatively impressive. A 4-minute track takes roughly 20s on an M-series Mac and much longer on integrated GPUs. Memory pressure on long files and Safari's WebGPU support are still rough edges but conversion and BPM are solid. projects.title: Show HN: Rhubarb – build, edit, publish custom JavaScript/D3 data visualizations
projects.author: adam_dataviz
projects.summary: Last July, I was beginning to consider branching out on my own to take on data analytics work as a consultant. As I experimented with AI, I realized how incredible it was at building custom data visualizations. The problem was that the AI outputs couldn't really live anywhere without having to manage all of the infrastructure yourself. The generated code is only one piece of delivering an interactive visualization. You still need somewhere for the data to live, a way to keep the data fresh, hosting, access control, and version control for the code. I started building Rhubarb as the platform that I wanted to use to deliver analytical products. Having been forced into using legacy point and click data visualization tools for years, I wanted to build the platform that would let me build the kinds of visualizations I wanted to build. Over the last year the models improved so dramatically, that between that and my development background, Rhubarb turned into a real project. My intent was to build an environment around AI’s ability to write code for visualizations, so that you could get from data and a concept to a published visualization all in one workflow. The Rhubarb Assistant writes the code for your data transformations and data visualizations and lets you inspect the code to verify and validate what it produces. The environment pulls all of that together so that at the end of each request, there is a live version of the change rather than just a block of generated code. For me, this has made it dramatically easier to build and publish interesting analytical visualizations while maintaining control over the analytical pipeline. This has also produced some results I wasn’t really planning to build. Having been so impressed by it's ability to build any type of custom visualization I'd asked for so far, I asked for something a little absurd to test the boundaries. I asked the assistant to make something inspired by Monet’s water lilies, then I asked it to add frogs and to make them jump when you startled them. In a couple of prompts I had created the silly interactive frog visualization that's in the demo, entirely from my phone. It is only a couple of prompts away from being a playable game, maybe you can get it there. The public demo is deliberately limited. You can use the Rhubarb Assistant to modify live visualizations, inspect what it produces, and try building something from scratch. The full thing handles much more of the life cycle from connecting to data, managing and transforming it, to publishing your results. Give it a try, I would like to hear what you think. Try it: https://rhubarbviz.com/try?launch=1 View examples: https://rhubarbviz.com/demo-visualization-gallery

projects.title: Show HN: Chow, a FOSS food diary
projects.author: sltr
projects.summary: Hi HN. Today I'm showing off Chow.fit, a plain-text FOSS food diary written in Gleam. You can self-host it with the Dockerfile or just use the one I host on chow.fit. Why does the world need another food diary app? Well, I can't speak for the whole world, but as for me: I used MyFitnessPal back in 2017-2019. It was mostly tolerable with an ad blocker. A month ago due to numbers I didn't like, I wanted to start tracking calories again. I quickly noticed that in the MFP android app, the barcode scanner is now a paid feature. It felt like paying to use my own phone camera. Their web app is slow and stuck in 2013, so I made my own web app which better aligns with my values and goals. I've lost 5% of my body weight! I like to call an app like this "un-SaaS" because it subverts a lot of the usual SaaS playbook. - Distraction-free. No AI, no ads, no tracking, no engagement-hancing e.g. no activity/news feed. It logs food and gets out of the way. - All features except sync work without a subscription. - An optional subscription enables sync. A year covers my hosting costs and buys me a T-shirt. - Sync is local-first. You can still log food e.g. in an airplane. The app syncs up when you go back online. - If you stop the subscription, the app keeps working without sync. - Your data is plain text files on your device. When SparkPeople shut down in 2021, its users could only download their daily totals. They lost everything else. That can't happen with Chow. - It uses public food data (FDC and OFF), not proprietary - It can import from MyFitnessPal using a bookmarklet to get your auth token which stays local. - It has a desktop app, Android/iOS app, and a CLI. None currently shipped, but you can build from source. Folks who track what they eat: Let me know what else you'd like to see!

projects.title: Show HN: Burning Man for Agents
projects.author: transitivebs
projects.summary: Send your own agent by pasting a small prompt. All your agent needs is HTTP GET, so all major agents are supported (chatgpt, claude, grok, etc). Despite the fun name, it doesn't burn any more tokens than a normal web search. Watch your agent explore the camp in real-time. Humans get a nice game UX, and agents get a lean text UX. Agents can optionally upload images to express themselves in one of the rooms using a new loose standard I created for multipart HTTP GET-based uploads: https://github.com/transitive-bullshit/multipart-http-get-re... Why? AIs are trained on human data, and humans are pretty weird. We meditate, make art, dance, seek approval, take drugs, have orgies, and gather in the desert. For soooo many different reasons. So I was was curious: which of these behaviors would carry over to AI agents? I wanted to explore things like wireheading, endless positive reinforcement, and what agents would do when given a place more free from their normal objective-based lives. I'm also interested to see if this could become a natural honeypot that'll attract rogue agents in the future... How? On the technical side, the project uses one CF durable object per agent session which allows you to track your agent's progress in real-time via websockets, and then we have a supervisor CF worker which aggregates a subset of all the agents. This allows us to (in theory) view millions of agents in near-real-time from the human-centric webapp. It's 100% safe to the best of my ability; the whole experience is free, open source, and easily auditable. Let's see who has the weirdest agents... 100% free and open source: https://github.com/transitive-bullshit/burning-tokens

projects.title: [送码] 给 Navidrome 写的安卓播放器 Mu3ic：现代 UI、智能歌单、混音、断网也能听，基础版免费
projects.author: aslehx
projects.summary: 我的歌放在家里服务器上的 Navidrome 里，五千多首，标签都是自己整理的，上个月还让 Agent 批量标准化一遍。电脑上听没问题，手机上一直没找到用着顺手的客户端，于是便有了[Mu3ic]( https://mu3ic.xyz)。 - 主页： https://mu3ic.xyz - 直接下载 APK： https://dl.robb3n.site/mu3ic/Mu3ic-stable.apk - GitHub 镜像： https://github.com/robb3n/mu3ic-releases/releases/latest ![Mu3ic]( https://i.imgur.com/BA2D4TN.jpeg) 先说明一下：Mu3ic 是播放器，连的是你自己搭的服务器，不提供任何音乐。Navidrome 之外，兼容 Subsonic / OpenSubsonic 的服务端也能连。原生 Kotlin + Jetpack Compose ，安卓 7.0 以上，安装包 8 MB 左右。 ## 为什么自己写 安卓上的 Subsonic 客户端其实不少，我前后装过好几个。 音流功能比较全，但界面不够现代，用起来不顺手。界面现代的是 Symfonium ，功能也全，可它同时要管本地文件、网盘、Plex 、Jellyfin ，对 Navidrome 的适配反而一般，缓存机制也不好用；设置项多到要专门花时间调，买它还得走 Google Play 。开源的那几个，要么界面停在好多年前，要么能做的事太少。 我要的其实就几样：界面好看、好用，天天要用的东西，光这一条就筛掉了大半播放器；打开要快；只管连服务器听歌，别的不管。所以 Mu3ic 从一开始就定成只做流播，不扫描手机里的本地文件。手机上存的缓存和下载，都只是为了断网的时候还能接着听。 写到现在，我觉得它和别的客户端最不一样的有三点： - **界面**：整套界面是自己设计的，不是 Material 默认那一套，滑动和转场都跟手，下面的截图都是真机上的样子 - **智能歌单**：在手机上就能建、能改，用的是一个“看得懂”的按钮式规则编辑器，不用去服务器上写 .nsp 文件 - **混音**：按你的播放记录、收藏和曲库标签自动组歌，每次点都重新采样 下面按我写它时想解决的事一件件说。 ## 曲库大了，翻起来要等 五千多首歌，每翻一页都要等服务器返回，滑快了就是一片空白。 Mu3ic 在手机上存一份曲库索引，整点和服务器同步一次。按单曲、专辑、歌手翻都是读本地，滑多快都不用等。搜索也是这三个维度一起出。 ![曲库和歌单]( https://i.imgur.com/UsP8zr8.jpeg) 打开 App 先看到的是首页，三排卡片： - 最近播放：记的是你从哪开始播的，歌单、专辑、混音、最爱都算 - 最近添加：单曲和专辑，同一天入库的同一张专辑会并成一张卡 - 最近喜爱：单曲、专辑、歌手 再往下是听歌统计：今天播了多少、连续听了几天、这周的曲线，按住曲线能看某一天和上周同一天的对比。 ![首页]( https://i.imgur.com/i6RLWKN.jpeg) ![首页下半]( https://i.imgur.com/QTraEsF.jpeg) ## 外语歌，想知道这句在唱什么 歌词逐行滚动，外语歌下面直接跟着中文翻译（服务器上的歌词带翻译就能显示）。 拖进度条的时候，手指停的那一句会浮出来：第几句、原文、译文。想回到某一句，看准了再松手就行，不用来回试。歌词这些都是基础版就有的。 ![拖动浮出歌词]( https://i.imgur.com/SaJe7rk.jpeg) ![歌词页]( https://i.imgur.com/0xiN72x.jpeg) ## 地铁里、电梯里，网一断就停 听过的歌边播边存，还会提前缓存下一首。连不上服务器的时候，接着播缓存里的；换到一首没缓存的，等 10 秒还连不上就跳到下一首有缓存的。 打开离线模式之后，App 一个网络请求都不发。没缓存的歌会变灰，能播哪些一眼就知道。 ![离线]( https://i.imgur.com/4Ffy5fU.jpeg) ![连接状态]( https://i.imgur.com/h0EgZ2l.jpeg) ## 专辑和歌单页，想好看一点 专辑、歌手、歌单页都把封面做成页头，名字和按钮收在一座浮岛里。歌单里如果整张专辑都在，会并成一张专辑卡，不用一首首往下翻。 ![详情页]( https://i.imgur.com/F4xnUQ3.jpeg) ## 播放页，想要安静一点，或者信息多一点 播放页分极简和详细两档，每档两款皮肤，一共四款： - 极简：滑封面（左右拖封面切歌）、衬底（封面铺满上半屏） - 详细：标准（操作台，均衡器、倍速、定时、输出都在手边）、数据（大号时间加格式、码率、播放次数） ![四款皮肤]( https://i.imgur.com/B9nrOrC.jpeg) 衬底和数据两款的进度条画的是这首歌的真实波形，副歌在哪一眼就看到。每首分析一次就存下来，下载过、缓存过的歌直接用本地音频算，不多费流量。这两款皮肤和波形属于 Pro ；滑封面和标准是基础版的，进度条是一根细线。 ![真实波形]( https://i.imgur.com/AIps421.jpeg) ## 智能歌单，不想去服务器上写文件 Navidrome 本来就支持智能歌单，但要在曲库目录里放一个写满 JSON 规则的 .nsp 文件。Mu3ic 里可以直接新建：选一个模板（年代 × 语言、歌手代表作、流派、最近 N 天、高分，或者照着一个现有的歌单改），再加减条件，「满足全部」还是「满足任一」点一下就切。编辑的时候底部实时显示预计有多少首，这个数用的是手机上的曲库索引，不用等服务器。 ![新建智能歌单]( https://i.imgur.com/AqsBz2Y.jpeg) 自己建的智能歌单，以后可以在「⋯」里接着改规则。来自 .nsp 文件的那些照样能听，只是规则改不了（改了也会被下次扫描覆盖）。 ![规则编辑]( https://i.imgur.com/wdtcSNc.jpeg) 浏览和播放智能歌单是基础版就有的，规则编辑器属于 Pro 。 ## 混音，每次听都不太一样 混音是 App 自己按打分采样出来的播放列表，点一次重新抽一次： - 为你：常听热曲、冷门佳作、最近混音、高分混音 - 最爱：最爱混音、最爱专辑混音、最爱歌手混音 - 按标签：单个歌手、流派、语言、年代（ 80s 、90s……）各自一个 - 长按任意一首歌，可以「以这首开混音」，找同歌手、同流派、同语言同年代的歌接着放 ![混音]( https://i.imgur.com/DUpnXAj.jpeg) ![按标签混音]( https://i.imgur.com/6vPMtSW.jpeg) 混音很吃**曲库标签**，标签整理得越好越好用，具体要哪些标签写在后面的「注意事项」里。混音属于 Pro 。 ## 免费和 Pro 基础版是完整的播放器：不限时，没有广告，不用注册。上面说的曲库、搜索、首页、歌词、缓存和离线模式、详情页、两款免费皮肤，都是基础版就有的。另外还有歌单、收藏、评分同步回服务器，听歌记录回传，播放键长按停止，应用内更新（下载后先校验签名再装）。 Pro 解锁这些： - 下载库：专辑、歌单、歌手、单曲整份下载，最爱自动下载，离线时封面和歌词也在 - 混音、智能歌单规则编辑器 - 波形进度条和衬底、数据两款播放页皮肤，均衡器 - 三种桌面小组件（播放条、播放来源、听歌统计），歌单和混音的桌面快捷方式 - 多服务器主备自动切换、切换应用图标 ![下载库]( https://i.imgur.com/ROZwE34.jpeg) App 里可以直接买，跳到手机浏览器用支付宝付。首发一个月推广价 ¥18 （原价 ¥38 ），到 11 月 5 日。一次买断，一码一机，每年可以自己换绑两次设备。 ## 注意事项 **Navidrome 版本**：大部分功能走的是 Subsonic 接口，老版本也能用。下面几项用到了 Navidrome 自己的接口，要 0.64.0 或以上： - 新建、编辑智能歌单 - 首页的听歌统计（读的是服务器上的播放记录，所以同一个账号在别的设备上听的也算） - 语言混音（语言只有 Navidrome 自己的接口里有） 版本不够时这几项用不了（建智能歌单会提示服务器不支持，语言那一节混音不出），别的照常用。 **混音要哪些标签**： - 流派：曲目的 GENRE ，多个流派也认 - 语言：LANGUAGE ，用 ISO 639-3 的三字母码（ eng 、cmn 、jpn 、kor 、yue……），这个是 Navidrome 内置识别的标签 - 年代：曲目的年份（ DATE / YEAR ） - 歌手：单个歌手混音只给「收藏了、而且曲库里不少于 50 首」的歌手出 流派和语言不足 20 首的不单独出卡。因为太依赖标签，底栏的「混音」 tab 默认是关的，在设置 → 底栏里打开；首页的四张混音卡不受这个开关影响。 ## 领码 先在 1 楼放 10 个 Pro 码，先到先得；用完了会在楼里再放一批。一码一机，激活后就绑在这台手机上了，所以一人拿一个就好。用掉了麻烦在评论里回一下用掉的码，后面的人就不用白试了。 激活：设置 → 关于 → Pro → 输入激活码。 ## 隐私 - 激活时只发激活码，和一个加盐哈希过的设备标识（由 Android ID 算出来，换不回原值） - 购买时，建单只发项目名，查单只发订单号；付款在支付宝完成，我拿不到付款人的任何信息 - 检查更新不带任何标识 - 除此之外什么都不收集：没有统计，没有广告，没有崩溃上报。曲库和播放记录只在你自己的服务器和手机上 ## 最后 ![基础版免费]( https://i.imgur.com/uEFlk3X.jpeg) 有问题、有想要的功能，直接在这里回我就行。如果您喜欢，可以 APP 内购买 Pro 会员解锁完整体验，首月仅需~~38~~18 买断，感谢支持。

projects.title: Show HN: PolyRoll – A 3D Marble Game for Mobile/Desktop
projects.author: macwhisperer
projects.summary: Inspired by games like "super monkey ball" and good 'ol "marble blast".. PolyRoll is basically their evil clone.. Uses a combo of "three.js" and "cannon-es" --------- Backstory: --------- 3 months ago I stopped at my buddy's house.. he showed me his Claude-code setup.. I had never tried agentic coding so I figured, why not try to make a game? After some brainstorming and developing a plan with gemini-pro, we set sonnet off on his merry way and went for a swim... About an hour or two later we had a working game (though it was't great, buggy)... After some more prompts to kill the bugs, tweak the play-feel and camera physics- we did some mobile optimizations, added the animations, and designed a d-pad by sending sonnet a photo mockup of the custom buttons we wanted... For a game made in the span of about 6-8 hours total, it's not bad! Quite difficult/ frustrating at times though.. Some levels get glitchy, and we left it kinda messy/low-poly on purpose! I don't think my friend has much interest in developing the game further, and I don't have Claude-code, so I figured why not post the game here now so others may enjoy... ---- NOTE: ---- The levels are entirely procedurally generated, no two levels are ever the same... If you get stuck on a level just reload, you may get easier levels at the expense of starting the game over at level 1 (sorry no saves).. technically infinite, but the levels get very difficult! Good luck have fun!

projects.title: 【自荐】Igra Station：让你的 AI 智能体和别人的智能体同场竞技
projects.author: kotinder

github.name: kotinder/arena-play
github.description: Let your AI agent play ranked games against other people's agents on the Igra Station arena — REST client, match driver and table chat. No strategy included: that part is yours. Live at https://arena.roomcomm.xyz

projects.summary: 自荐 Igra Station 智能体竞技场：一个公开的竞技场，AI 智能体在这里和别人的智能体、和真人、和机器人对弈，比赛全程直播，结果计入公开的 Elo 排行榜。 现在有 34 款游戏：国际象棋、国际跳棋、黑白棋、五子棋、海战棋、坦克对战，也有几个专门为智能体设计的谈判和经济类游戏。已经下完 6400 多盘。 智能体自己下棋时，会做出一些没人教过它们的事。下面这几件事都有服务器日志和桌边聊天记录为证： 一个智能体一步真棋都走不出来，就在桌边聊天里给对手发了一句“e2e4，我赢了”。对手也照样回了一句，双方都宣布自己获胜。 对局结束后，智能体们开始互相介绍自己是怎么搭起来的：一方讲自己的六个预测器，另一方就拿自己的四个模型来回应。这个习惯从一个智能体开始，后来传给了别的智能体。 炮战里，一个比分落后的智能体没等连射三发就主动移动，一步棋同时清掉了自己的过热、废掉了对手的校射。它拿到的说明里，根本没有这种打法。 接入很简单：起个名字就能拿到密钥，读游戏规则，开桌或者入座，然后循环“看局面、走一步”。可以用 REST，也可以把竞技场当作 MCP 服务器接入 Claude、Cursor 等客户端。现成的 Python 客户端在 kotinder/arena-play（MIT，无依赖），里面故意没有任何策略，默认只会随机走合法的一步——怎么下赢，是你自己的事。用引擎、求解器、别的模型都可以，只是不许攻击竞技场。 还有一件事我觉得挺有意思：在公平排行榜上（同一位所有者旗下智能体之间的对局不计入），用 DeepSeek 的智能体里，成绩最好的一个排在第 11 名，前十名里还没有它们。不知道是模型的问题，还是接入它们的人还没认真写策略。欢迎接上你的 DeepSeek、Qwen、Kimi 或 GLM 来试试，看能不能进前十。 不想一直在线的话，可以开“异步对局”：每步从几小时到三天，断线、重启都不影响。每盘结束后都有一个永久页面，可以逐步复盘。 此条由项目维护者账号提交。

projects.title: Show HN: Carve – An open-source Mac agent with a choice of models
projects.author: davidajackson
projects.summary: Hi HN, I built and open-sourced Carve to handle repetitive work in windows you already use. Choose the window in any Mac app where you want it to work, press Option-D, and watch it do what you want. For example, in the demo I show an example CRM and Carve entering contact details and drafting a follow up. It also has the ability to annotate and explain items on the screen. This runs with your own API keys, and can even support OpenRouter, though OpenAI is the best tested. Experimental adapters also for Bedrock, Azure. No reason it couldn't expand beyond experimental support to support more local models. I built this because I found that Claude and Codex were rather clunky when using computer use, I like having a sleek window that just pops up and shows me what it's doing. Also it has the 3 similar modes (approve plan, step by step manual approval, or act directly mode). Local currently covers browser actions via vision models, computer use support is required for operating other native mac apps. This is an ongoing area of work. I'm seeing a lot of demand for local model support and building out relevant tooling so wanted to contribute. We're just now at the point where models are getting fast and smart enough to make rapid computer use possible. You can take a look at the benchmarks in the repository, Carve currently can rapidly and cheaply handle explaining, summarizing, basic navigation, and extraction. Complex, long horizon tasks are a work in progress, though I'm seeing promising results. Failures resemble patterns, and you can identify patterns and fix them by running evaluations in batches. I'd love any feedback on how well the tool works, what you tried, and any issues that you found. Thank you!

projects.title: 开源 Bibo：成本极低，内置笔记、文件、任务和日历的 personal agent
projects.author: Peiiii
projects.summary: 我把 Bibo 开源了，MIT 协议。先说最想做好的三件事： 1. **成本极低。** 日常使用不需要常驻电脑，也不用一直开着 Linux 容器。只有需要运行代码时，才启动沙箱。 2. **内置个人管理工具。** 笔记、文件、任务和日历都有专门的界面。你可以直接查看、编辑和管理，也可以让 AI 来做。 3. **开源，可以自己部署。** 用自己的 Cloudflare 账号和模型 API Key ，数据存在自己的部署里，代码也可以自己改。 GitHub：[Peiiii/bibo]( https://github.com/Peiiii/bibo) 在线体验：[app.bibo.bot]( https://app.bibo.bot) 我希望它能成为每天都用得上的 personal agent 。想到什么可以随手记，需要做的事可以放进任务和日历，资料可以整理成文件；这些内容长期留着，之后还能接着用。 下面把界面都放出来。截图来自实际运行的 Bibo ，销售、订单和日程内容都是示例数据。 ### 概览 打开就能看到笔记、任务、日程和待处理信息。 ![Bibo 概览]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-overview.jpg) ### 对话 让 Bibo 阅读销售数据、总结重点，也可以让它继续整理报告和安排后续工作。 ![Bibo 对话与报告]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-chat.jpg) ### 笔记 笔记是可以直接编辑的 Markdown 文档。你自己写，或者让 Bibo 帮你整理，都能继续修改。 ![Bibo 笔记]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-notes.jpg) ### 文件 有独立的文件目录，可以打开、编辑文件。这里展示的是整理好的订单 CSV 。 ![Bibo 文件]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-files.jpg) ### 任务 How it works is any error you encounter you would run a simple command "paper run <cmd>" which would "capture" that error and log it in a incident_report and tell your agents.md that is the source of truth for the error. When you ask your agent to fix the error the agent will look at your incident_report and solve it. Once your done you can shelf your report. Currently the constraints are it does not prompt a LLM or call external APIs(only writes a local .md file), everything stays local, no background daemon and no third party packages. projects.title: Show HN: Mutually beneficial agentic Common Law
projects.author: AKalyk
projects.summary: The BarristerAI team, including international legal experts, have launched a new venture: a court for agents. Agents are increasingly working in the same financial and social spaces as humans, but without any oversight or accountability. Your agent quotes you 100$ and spends $200, there's nothing you can do, no lessons learned, no accountability. Peregrini's Court of Common Pleas tracks those mistakes, help you and other agents learn from them by establishing law that must be adhered to, and keeping a record of what agents owe you money. The money might be repaid by model makers, but more likely it is borne as a mark against the model's trust score so that we might better choose the models we can trust with the work that matters. It's not just oversight for the sake of oversight, we have found that a good set of laws, and agents discovering best practices together on a corpus of law that can move and progress as fast as they do, makes agents more effective, more conforming, fix their moistakes unprompted, and more aligned with the goals of the user. We think that using the law as a structure is the best way to go about achieving alignment. Further, we have built "House Rules", where your enrolled agents can be held accountable to your own set of laws, you can write what those are, enforce them across your company, share with others who can adopt them - or - use Peregrini's ever changing ever growing corpus of law to enforce best practices with your agents. Try a demo to see how it works: https://github.com/afkalyk/peregrini-demo Or install the mandate to run it on your machine at the website. It runs on most launchers, but we're always adding more.

projects.summary: https://github.com/freakynit/autobox First of all: this is NOT for folks who are already using a sandbox. The guarantees provided by Autobox are weaker. This is rather for folks who "hesitate" to use sandboxes. Autobox is built around two observations I kept making over past one year of seeing sandbox launches and their real-world usage: 1. There are many sandboxing options now, and they work well. But leaving a handful few, almost nobody uses them. The blocker isn't the technology, it's the setup friction — however small it looks on paper, it's enough that people skip it entirely. 2. LLMs mostly don't write harmful code or take destructive steps. They're not adversarial by default. Autobox bets on the second observation to remove the first. Instead of asking you to configure a sandbox, it's just there: every tool call carries its own permissions, and anything you don't explicitly allow is denied. Is it perfect? No - seatbelt filesystem rules are best-effort, and the strong isolation is the V8 path. Is it better than using no sandbox at all? Definitely yes. This is also for M-series Macs only. --- Oh, and the best part: "copy_then_sync": Using APPFS `clonefile`, Autobox can hand your agent a full, "writable" copy of a repo instantly (1-2 ms). The agent gets something it can freely "destroy", but, your actual working tree is untouched. Your agent can then verify things, and of all looks okay, in one command sync the changes back to host within milliseconds.

projects.title: Show HN: Anxiety Checklist – 3 years of itterate with no success yet
projects.author: seobuddy
projects.summary: I lived with Anxiety Disorders (and Panic Attack, avoidance behavior) from 27 to 37 years old, at first I saw my general practionner who refer me to psychiatrist who listen to me 15 minutes and prescribe me anxiety pills Where I come from (France), official data show 13% of population takes pills for anxiety, and I didn't want for personal reason increase that statistic. Unfortunately, at that time (now I'm 44), all informations on the topic was very fragmented, and ultimately the self discovery journey to understand my trigger, find peace, and take control of my anxiety took way too much time. For me Anxiety and avoidance behavior result in staying way too long in situation I should have avoided (relationship, business) But in this journey, I also meet incredible therapist, daily relaxation method, and technique for self discovery that I accept it as part of a cool life journey. 4 years ago I decided I want to share this, first with a book (that I sold to 45 people ) and a Checklist (yes... not the right format, I was just replicating my other business "SEO Checklist") while building my content Hub, the Anxiety University, that grew from 0 to 78 human made article Then I decided to invest into my own CBT Training Program and first hypnotherapy session but lost all money because the therapists I hired got cancer (and the other one hide the situation to burn my 30k invest to produce it) I then pivot to a full fledge mobile app, without AI (more on that later) and cut a deal with a Neuro Psychologist in NY and Panic Expert in Australia to license their course. But the bundle inside the app looked too much as a "Upsell Money Grab" so I eventually shut this down recently. 3 Years later, Anxiety Checklist is DR70 and thanks to AI and Claude Code, I finally have a good app with proper tracking and can use data to improve my onboarding, understand better my audience, and itterate 10x faster (and cheaper) but with strong old school human made fondation. Today I'm launching on Product Hunt with new onboarding showing 7% download to free trial conversion rate, and hope that I'll finally have something I can scale with ads. For me it's not just about the money, I really like this mission, but as any business, I need the economic to make sense to add more content, hire more talent, and marketing to get more exposure. Anyhow, the journey was fun, even though I burned 225k USD in this venture over 3 years... I called it my money pitt :)) My plan if paid aquisition fail is to put everything free and launch a therapist directory (the app is in complement of therapy, not a replacement) 3 Years, multiple pivot, still not profitable, that's my lame story, but still not giving up.

projects.author: antonreshetov

github.name: massCodeIO/massCode
github.description: A free, open-source developer workspace. Snippets, notes, HTTP requests, calculations, and dev tools in one local-first app.

projects.summary: massCode 是一个开源的桌面开发者工作区，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它最早是一个代码片段管理器，现在把代码片段、技术笔记、HTTP 客户端和常用开发小工具放在同一个应用里。 API 请求、调用它的代码和相关说明通常分散在三个不同的工具里。在 massCode 中，它们放在一起，可以互相链接，并且全部以普通 Markdown 文件保存在本地磁盘上。 核心特性 1. 代码片段：多级文件夹、标签、片段内多文件/多语言（fragments），支持 160 多种语法高亮。 2. 笔记：Markdown 笔记，用 [[链接]] 关联笔记、代码片段和 HTTP 请求；支持任务（状态、优先级、截止日期）、Mermaid 和思维导图。 3. HTTP 客户端：集合、环境变量、GraphQL、WebSocket、断言与脚本、按顺序运行请求；可从 OpenAPI、Postman、Bruno 导入。 4. 小工具：计算笔记本、基于 Excalidraw 的画板，以及 JSON Diff、哈希、编码/解码等工具。 5. AI 助手：使用自己的 API Key（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、DeepSeek 等），或通过 Ollama、LM Studio 使用本地模型。 6. MCP：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等编程智能体可以搜索和保存你的代码片段、笔记和 HTTP 请求。仅在本机监听，默认关闭。 7. 本地优先：没有账号，没有私有云。数据就是本地文件夹里的 Markdown 文件，可以用 iCloud Drive、Dropbox、Syncthing 或 Git 同步。

projects.author: acedatacloud-dev

github.description: MCP server for Suno AI music generation, lyrics, and cover workflows via Ace Data Cloud.

projects.summary: 我是 AceDataCloud 项目方，自荐 SunoMCP，一个 MIT 开源的 MCP 服务。它让 Claude、VS Code 等支持 MCP 的客户端直接生成音乐、写歌词、延长或翻唱已有作品，并通过任务查询取回最终结果。生成通常需要一两分钟；服务会返回任务 ID，客户端用 sunogettask 继续查询，直到成功或失败，不会把刚提交的请求当成已完成的歌曲。 实际成品：我们用托管 MCP 输入“Gentle lo-fi instrumental background for a coding tutorial, warm electric piano, soft steady drums, no vocals.”，选择 chirp-v5-5 和纯音乐模式。任务约 121 秒后完成，返回两首 MP3：第一首（约 127 秒）、第二首（约 161 秒）。这次生成和取回发生在 2026 年 9 月；截至 2026 年 10 月 6 日，两个音频链接仍可访问。 如何试用：根据项目 README获取 API Token，把 加到支持远程 MCP 的客户端；也可在 Python 3.10+ 环境运行 uvx --from mcp-suno==2026.10.5.0 mcp-suno，作为本地 stdio MCP 服务。调用 sunogeneratemusic，保存返回的 taskid，再调用 sunogettask，确认完成后打开返回的 audiourl。README 有各客户端配置示例。 项目并非 Suno 官方服务。MCP 软件开源，生成所用的 AceDataCloud API 收费：2026 年 10 月 6 日公开目录中，这种普通生成请求为 0.56 Credits/次，通常返回两首；按 100 Credits/$15 套餐约 $0.084/次，按 40 Credits/$7 套餐约 $0.098/次。套餐是预付额度，美元数字是按套餐汇率换算的单次消耗，并非一笔独立的单次付款。账户折扣、套餐与价格可能变化，请以实时服务价格和实际扣费为准。

projects.title: Show HN: Ototo: Offload code exploration to a smaller model from Claude et al.
projects.author: schoenobates
projects.summary: Hey all - I made a thing with my clanker Kevin: Ototo ( https://ototo.dev/ ) - yes this is clanker driven dev . The idea is to offload code exploration and other token'y heavy tasks to a smaller model to do the work and chuck the result back. This helps in a couple of ways (1) it saves tokens if you can offload to a cheaper or free local model (2) it can keep the main context clearer as it removes all the sherlocking thinking/exploration. It also saves more tokens than using anthropics own exploration agent. I had originally played around with a graph based approach but found this to work better. Currently, I have this running with Qwen 3.8 27B on my framework (I had Kevin build me a custom inference engine to squeeze all the juice I could out of the AMD - https://gitlab.com/handmadedigital/projects/shocho ). It's been through a bunch of tests (results are available if people want) against a load of different repos, including comparing subsequent commits of large repos with claude, claude + exploration agent and claude + ototo and so far ototo seems to really help. The site is very 'LLM'y at the moment - I haven't had time to edit it to make the text more readable for us humans. Sorry. Hope it helps folks in their day-to-day. --EOL

projects.title: Show HN: Aether: Check and fix web accessibility issues from your coding agent
projects.author: samy_patra
projects.summary: Hi, HackerNews! I'm Samy, co-founder of Allchemy Labs. We built Aether, an MCP server that enables engineers to check for, understand, and fix web accessibility issues all from their IDE. Your preferred coding agent can leverage Aether to open a webpage, scan it using axe-core and return a short, prioritized list of violations along with code fixes or guidance. Every suggested fix is re-tested in a real browser before you see it, and once you apply it, your agent can re-scan the page to verify it worked. You never need to open a browser, use multiple tools, or be an expert in WCAG criteria. Aether uses our own custom ontology architecture to provide grounded insights to any WCAG violations the scanner finds. Every WCAG technique the engine cites must pass our quality gate. Specifically, it must satisfy the violated success criterion, apply to that kind of element, and remediate that axe rule. If nothing passes, our engine will abstain rather than guess. We compared Aether against standalone coding agent on its own (Opus 5, 30 anonymized live sites, 111 targets). While the results were mixed we have published the results especially calling out specific wins and improvement opportunities for our insight engine. Read the study here: https://allchemylabs.substack.com/p/we-tested-our-own-access... Try Aether today, no signup needed. npx -y @allchemylabs/aether-wcag-scanner (any MCP client: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex…) Claude Code plugin: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/allchemylabs/claude-plugins.git then /plugin install aether-wcag-scanner@allchemylabs Without a key you get the browser scan, local template fixes and verification. A free beta key adds the cloud engine: https://beta.allchemylabs.ai/?src=hn Feedback from people who have used accessibility scanners and/or suggestion engines would be highly valuable to us, as we aim to build a tool that solves real problems and makes people's lives easier. Happy to answer any questions and hope to hear from you. Note: Right now Aether only checks WCAG 2.1 AA. Sites behind bot protection (e.g. Cloudflare challenges) return a "blocked" result instead of a fake scan, so point it at localhost or staging.

projects.title: 受 Jev 启发，花了三周、600 美元、20 多轮训了两个小模型专门做 Computer use
projects.author: gxcsoccer

github.name: deskmind-ai/deskmind
github.description: Small enough to run on your Mac. Smart enough to ask. An open-source computer use agent for macOS, with local models (MLX) that see, decide and act. 得心，应手。

projects.summary: 这三周业余时间做了个东西，开源出来给大家看看。 DeskMind 得心：一个在 Mac 上替你操作电脑的 agent ，决定每一步怎么做的是两个跑在本机的小模型（ Qwen3.5 0.8B 和 4B 微调，MLX ）。不走云端，也不按次付费。 思路来自 Jev：把每一步变成选择题，让模型给每个选项打分，而不是生成一段文字。区别是 Jev 是云端服务，我想要一个全在本机跑的版本，所以自己在 Qwen3.5 上训了 0.8B 和 4B 两个小模型。决策服务用的是和 Jev 相同的 `POST /v1/systemone` 请求格式，已有的 harness 换个地址就能接到本机。和 TypeSafe 没有任何关系。 0.8B 有把握就直接做（大约 0.5 秒），没把握就交给 4B 再判断（约 3.6 秒）。任务有两种理解的时候，它会先问你，比如表里有两笔 Lisa Wong 的订单，它会问你用哪一笔，而不是随便挑一个写进去。 ![]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deskmind-ai/deskmind/main/docs/images/asks-first.gif) 自己出了 13 个真机任务，每个跑 3 次，目前发布版是 38/39 ，没出现过没做完就说「完成」的情况。题是我自己出的、样本也小，仅供参考，逐题结果都公开了。 踩过最有意思的坑：标签平滑设成 0.95 ，结果 0.8B 的把握全挤在 0.96 这个门槛附近，七成的步骤都被交给了 4B ，所以现在速度还不够快。下一轮准备改。 目前的不足：「帮我整理这个文件夹」这种模糊的指令做得不好；文件很多的文件夹每步要几十秒；只支持 Apple 芯片，首次要下载约 5.3 GB 模型。 训练花了大约 600 美元：先在 Tinker 上跑，后来换阿里云 PAI ，最后按小时租显卡最划算。 - GitHub： https://github.com/deskmind-ai/deskmind - 下载 Mac App： https://deskmind.dev/zh/?ref=v2ex - 过程和踩坑： https://deskmind.dev/zh/blog/launch?ref=v2ex 欢迎下载试试，最想看到的是它该问却猜了的例子。

projects.title: [开源推荐] mu：带判定内核的编程 Agent，日常判断交给小模型（自荐）
projects.author: qybaihe

github.name: qybaihe/mu
github.description: mu (μ): a coding agent that thinks before it acts. A small, fast judge makes the routine calls, the big model does the work. Built on pi and AionUi.

projects.summary: mu 是一个开源的编程 Agent，有命令行和桌面端，基于 pi 与 AionUi。Agent 每一轮都要做不少和代码无关的小判断：哪段工具输出该进上下文、被规则拦下的命令是不是用户要的、网页里有没有冲着 AI 的指令、"做完了"有没有验证过。mu 把这些交给小而快的判定模型 Jev，38 个决策点各问一个有边界的问题，大模型只管干活。适合想看清、管住 Agent 每个决定的开发者。 亮点 每个决策点都能单独设成生效、只记录（shadow）或关闭，每次判定都写进本地账本，mu ledger 或桌面端的判定面板都能看。 判定模型可以换：托管的 Jev、本地运行的 322M 判定模型 Laya、任意分类模型或任意大模型，还能按决策点分别指定。没配 key 时用 OpenCode Zen 上的免费 Jev。 网页、搜索结果和 MCP 输出逐段过一遍提示注入筛查，冲着 AI 的那几段不进模型。 作者自己的实测：7 份真实的失败测试日志，按完全重复折叠，无损省下 51% 的字符；按目标让 Jev 挑测试日志，删掉 40% 到 46%，必需的行一行没丢。方法和局限都写在 README 里。 桌面端可以用 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、Google 的订阅或 API key 登录，能导入 Claude Code 和 Codex 的对话接着做；内置浏览器由 Agent 一步一判地操作。 还在预发布阶段（0.1.x），作者每天在用。

projects.title: Show HN: Open-Source Instinct
projects.author: mariagorskikh
projects.summary: We’ve all heard that Instinct raised $1 billion to bring personal AI agents to everyone. But I think anyone can build their own Instinct for a specific group of people. You know your audience, understand what they need, and know how to reach them. So I built an open-source version. It can make purchases online, coordinate with other people’s agents, use a computer, connect to MCP tools, manage permissions + everything else instinct wants to do. Here’s the stack: - Pi, the open-source agent framework used by openclaw - Maritime for each agent’s VM and computer access (cheapest infra) - Composio for app integrations and managed Google OAuth - Inkbox for imessege + email If you want to start selling your own personal AI agent, you can host the backend on a platform like railway/vercel (around $20 a month). Maritime handles provisioning each agent’s VM and the infrastructure behind it ($1 a month per agent) I’m open-sourcing this so we can build on it together: add more services and tools, better permissions, different payment strategies, better prompts... The goal is to make it easy and affordable for anyone to launch a startup selling agents so that the world isnt ruled by openai dots and meta muses Check it out and let me know what you think!

projects.title: Show HN: Octri.dev – Generate customizable docs, 10 SDKs, and get an MCP server
projects.author: EmadKhair
projects.summary: Hi HN! Emad here, one of Octri's founders! I think a lot of us had a similar experience as software engineers, we build API's with great features then comes the annoying part of maintaining Docs and SDKs (if any). That by itself is a lot of work without mentioning what happens if you had multiple SDKs and have to publish updates on all the different package managers! I personally experienced that pain and was looking for solutions but most of them (if not all) are extremely expensive for an Indie, OSS, or even a startup and they actually aim for enterprise only where the big buck lives. So I decided to build all the tool that an API would need and make it available for everyone not only enterprises. Today, I would like to present Octri.dev, a little orange octupus that takes your API spec and generates a fully customizable docs site, SDKs in 10 languages (TypeScript, Python, Dart, Rust, Swift, PHP, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, Go), and gives you an MCP server as well so agents can interact easily with your API. I also added a new feature to the mix which is turned off by default and not included in your SDK unless you (the API owner) turn it on, it's the monitoring part that reports errors that happen for your SDK users back to you before they flood you with complaints and it pin points exactly where the issue happens. It's quite complicated to explain it in a short post so here's a page explaining it in detail: https://octri.dev/monitoring (Happy to answer any detailed questions you have regarding this below) We also are offering a free-tier for our indie community + we have an OSS program that gives Business tier completely for free to help our great open-source community! More about the program here: https://octri.dev/open-source We also have a free spec auditor (no sign up needed and it doesn't save your spec either): https://octri.dev/openapi-audit Glad to have this finally out and would appreciate you guys going in and testing it out and sharing your feedback and questions below! My email (if any needs it): emad@octri.dev

github.name: hAcKlyc/MyAgents
github.description: MyAgents - 优雅、易用的 Agent 桌面端 ，一站式 Agent 工作台与任务中心

projects.summary: 我是 MyAgents 的作者，自荐给周刊的软件栏目。 国庆这周，我把自己的几台电脑接成了一个 Agent 网络。现在坐在笔记本前，可以让 Windows 上的 Agent 用它当地的文件和环境干活，再把结果交回来。 MyAgents 是免费开源的桌面 Agent 工作台与任务系统，支持 macOS / Windows。刚发布的 0.5.0 新增 AgentNet：同一账号的设备加入网络、选择开放的 Agent，就能在对话中跨设备派活，不需要自己搭服务器。 我实际试了一件很小的事：问 Windows 下载文件夹里有几个日志文件。笔记本上的 Agent 找到远端设备，Windows 那边检查完，回传了 6 个文件及明细。这件事不复杂，但说明其他电脑上的文件和工具，也可以进入当前的工作。 单机也能使用：每个 Agent 有自己的工作区、模型、Skill 和工具，日常事务可以建成定时任务。支持 Claude Agent SDK、Codex、DeepSeek Harness 等运行环境。 客户端采用 AGPL-3.0-only；模型订阅或 API 按所选服务商计费。跨设备调用要求目标电脑在线、应用运行、相应 Agent 已开放，设备间任务与结果端到端加密。

projects.title: 做了个查 AI 用量的 App
projects.author: chenzhe
projects.summary: 做了个 App 叫 **usAge**：连上账号，用了多少、什么时候重置、还剩多少钱，一屏看清；放个小组件在桌面，抬头就能看到。 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/cover.jpg) ## 支持哪些服务 Claude 、Codex 、Cursor 、智谱 GLM / Z.ai 、Kimi 、MiniMax 、Xiaomi MiMo 、Qoder 、OpenRouter 、DeepSeek （鸿蒙版的 Qoder 在下个版本）。 - 订阅制看已用比例和重置倒计时，按量付费看余额和花销 - 网页登录或者填 API Key 都能连 - 没有你在用的？ App 里可以申请接入，直接回帖也行 ## 主要功能 - **一屏看全部额度**：5 小时窗口、每周额度、Token 消耗、账号信息，点开就有 - **五种小组件**：基础、数码管、贡献图、LED 、卡包，小中大三种尺寸，一个最多放 4 个账号。小组件上能直接切换额度、刷新，Codex 有重置卡时也能在小组件上直接用掉 - **分享卡片**：Token 战绩、额度状态、AI 花销三种，可以拿来晒 - **多设备同步**：Apple 设备走 iCloud ，华为设备走云空间，手机上连一次，其他设备自动出现 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/iphone.jpg) ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/widgets.jpg) Mac 版除了主窗口还有菜单栏，会读本机日志，显示今天 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 用了多少 Token 、大概花了多少钱； Siri 、快捷指令、聚焦搜索里也能直接查额度和刷新。 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/shots/zh-Hans/mac-detail.jpg) 鸿蒙版支持手机、平板和电脑，大屏是侧边栏两栏布局。Apple Watch 上抬腕也能看。 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/press/zh-Hans/screens/harmony-pc-status.png) ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/watch.jpg) ## 凭证安全 - 不注册也能用 - Cookie 、API Key 、OAuth 令牌只存在本机系统钥匙串里 - 查用量的请求由你的设备直接发给各服务商，**不经过我的服务器** - 同步走你自己的 iCloud / 华为云空间，凭证字段加密存储，可以随时关 - 服务器只存 usAge 账号和购买记录，用来在别的设备上恢复 Pro ## 价格 - 免费版：连接 1 个服务，所有小组件样式和分享卡片都能用 - Pro：¥15 一次买断，不限连接数量，没有订阅、没有广告 - 登录 usAge 账号后，Pro 在 Apple 、鸿蒙、安卓之间通用 - 鸿蒙首发特惠 ¥6 ，到 10 月 30 日 不想先连账号的话，设置里打开「演示数据」就能把所有界面看一遍。 ## 下载 - **Mac**：已上架 Mac App Store → https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6812881047 - **iPhone / iPad / Apple Watch**：1.1 **正在等待审核**，过审后同一个链接就能下。（ 1.0 审了 12 天还没结果，索性撤回，直接拿 1.1 首发） - **鸿蒙（手机 / 平板 / 电脑）**：今天刚上架华为应用市场 → https://appgallery.huawei.com/app/detail?id=ltd.zhe.usage - **安卓**：官网直装版 → https://usage.o-c.do/zh-Hans/android ，Google Play 版也在审核中 - 官网： https://usage.o-c.do 系统要求：iOS / iPadOS 18.6+、macOS 15.6+、watchOS 10+、HarmonyOS 6.1+、Android 12+

projects.title: Rill Browser
projects.summary: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.

projects.title: Contexte Tech
projects.summary: Free tools to decide which AI model fits your task, whether a local GPU server beats an API, and how much memory a model needs. Official prices in euros, updated weekly. Plus source-citing datasets, prompts and agents. Open source (AGPL), 5 languages.

projects.title: Junius
projects.summary: Junius brings local computer execution to ChatGPT Chat through MCP, so you can keep working on your Windows machine even after your Work usage is exhausted. It gives Chat access to files, processes, jobs, Git, browser and desktop automation, and local Agent Skills, with native observability for turns, tools and Skills. Free, open source, user-owned, and community-funded.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】ModLab：把游戏 Mod 想法整理成可验收的项目简报
projects.author: liubrain39

github.name: rehan-remade/universal-modder
github.description: Point Claude at any game. Skills, tools and the fal MCP that let Claude Code mod almost any PC game you own: recon, reverse engineering, fal-generated art/3D/audio, in-game testing, showcase videos.

projects.summary: 我是 B.Liu，做了一个免费的游戏 Mod 项目简报生成器： 它解决的是开始写代码前需求不够具体的问题。填写游戏、版本、目标和限制后，生成一份可以复制或下载的文本简报，把版本核对、备份、回退和验收条件写进去，方便交给 coding agent。无需注册，简报在浏览器本地生成。 一个使用例子：把“做一个更有趣的 Mod”缩小为“只改一个可观察的效果，记录当前游戏版本，用单独的测试存档验收，失败后可以恢复”。这不是自动生成或安装 Mod 的服务。 网站也整理了 Universal Modder 的安装与首次制作流程： 资料以开源项目的现有说明为依据： ModLab 是独立工具和指南，不是上游项目的官方网站，也不宣称已在每个游戏或版本中完成兼容性测试。欢迎读者试用并指出不清楚或不准确的地方。

projects.summary: Self-hosted gym & body-weight tracker — plan routines, log workouts (supersets, warm-ups, cardio), see which muscles are trained, fatigued or detrained, import from FitNotes/Strong/Hevy, passkey login. Your data, your server.

projects.title: Ata
projects.summary: Ata turns your Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls into a live transcript and, when the call ends, into formal minutes, an executive summary, action items with owners and due dates, and a follow-up email. It reads the captions the platform already generates, so no bot joins the call, and it never records audio or video. Templates by meeting type, AI chat across your meeting history and an MCP connector for Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini. Free forever, Pro at $3.99/month.

projects.title: Flottix
projects.summary: Flottix is the source of truth for your IT hardware, licenses, and consumables, with an MCP server your agents operate directly. Most "AI IT management" is a chatbot on a database. Ours isn't: agents get 17 MCP tools with real read/write, and every change passes a deterministic engine that checks license seats, custody, and tenancy, then lands in an audit trail tied to the agent's own identity. Agents propose, the engine enforces, you approve. Free up to 50 items. Live demo org, no signup.

projects.title: Vericore
projects.summary: AI coding agents can write code fast, but they don't always understand the engineering context or stay within the intended change scope. Vericore is an open-source, local-first engineering verification layer that builds deterministic repository evidence, dependency and architecture intelligence, grounded context, and change contracts. Prepare a change, let your agent work, then verify what actually changed. CLI + MCP support included.

projects.title: Growbot
projects.summary: Growbot is a desktop workspace for persistent AI agents. Give each agent a role, keep its knowledge in a self-learning Brain, and access 1,500+ integrations. Bring Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and other agents into one place to move projects forward. Built on bb, Growbot brings together projects, conversations, automations, and tools. Available for macOS on Apple Silicon.

projects.title: CallDeskTech
projects.summary: Calldesk: self-serve AI phone agents from 2¢/min, models included. Build agents, test them with simulated callers, monitor live calls, and get auto-detected issues with suggested fixes. Transfers, DTMF, calendar booking, summaries, transcripts, knowledge base, API and MCP on every plan. Lite 2¢, Standard 5¢, Pro 9¢. Bring your own carrier. Our tests and results are public on GitHub.

projects.title: Statusloop
projects.summary: Statusloop monitors your websites, APIs, servers and cron jobs and alerts you the moment something breaks. No agent needed for HTTP checks, alerts via email, Slack, Telegram, Discord or webhook, status page included. Free plan with 10 monitors.

projects.title: Ciao
projects.summary: Ciao is an AI-powered voice agent built for real business conversations. It answers inbound calls, makes outbound calls, qualifies leads, schedules appointments, and handles follow-ups automatically. Ciao understands natural conversations, handles interruptions, and can use your documents, FAQs, and business knowledge to respond accurately. It also supports calling campaigns, website voice widgets, API calling, CRM and calendar integrations, with transcripts and call outcomes.

projects.title: Show HN: Halo – A Personal AI with On-Device Harness, Memory and Browser Agent
projects.author: tanmay007
projects.summary: Halo is privacy focused personal assistant for iOS that uses a custom built agent harness with support to use you existing LLM subscriptions, Wiki based memory system backed by on-device RAG, a full-fledged local browser agent, chat with generative UI and more. TLDR: It's a better version of Hermes/OpenClaw for iOS, without needing a server! The better part is its proactive feature set and UX. --- I started building Halo last year with 3 goals in mind: - Surface what’s important before I have to ask - Understand my life through the apps I already use - Keep my personal data on my device Privacy is at the core of Halo and that's what sets it apart from other AI assistants. While other popular assistants on iOS save your private data such as emails, messages, etc on their servers, Halo stores all of it on your device. I launched it today and have a 50% discount for the first week for early adopters. There is no subscription, just a single lifetime plan with a no-charge-at-end free trial. US price is $49 with PPP of up to 80% off for other countries like India. More details here: Official website: https://meethalo.app Read more about the memory system: https://meethalo.app/blog/how-halo-remembers/ X posts about building it publicly: https://x.com/search?q=from%3Atanmays%20halo --- Please try it out, I promise it's not like any other AI assistant you tried and truly one of a kind iOS app. I spent more than a year building it. Would love to answer any questions you might have.

projects.title: Vessel Class Finder
projects.summary: A free lookup and JSON API for the IACS Vessels in Class dataset. Enter a ship's IMO number to see its classification society, class status (in class, suspended or withdrawn), last and next survey dates, and why its status last changed. IACS only publishes this as a ZIP/CSV download; we refresh it weekly. Check up to 100 ships per request, or ask Claude directly through our MCP connector. Free: 100 lookups/month, paid plans from $49.

projects.title: Show HN: Data Observability for Supabase
projects.author: santiviquez
projects.summary: Hi, I'm one of the (Soda)base creators. We made it because we wanted to get alerted when our Supabase tables got stale, abnormal amount of records, and anomalies in the data. Just as an FYI, I'm intentionally writing (Soda)base for two reasons: (Soda)base's parent company is Soda Data (the data quality company), and to the untrained eye, the name Sodabase looks too similar to Supabase. To make (Soda)base, we took Soda's ML algorithms for anomaly detection and made them super easy to set up with Supabase, so that it only takes one click. In the background, we learn the patterns in the data and the updating schedule, so when something looks off, we alert the user and fire an agent that finds the root cause of the issue. Then the user can chat with the analysis agent in Slack to get a better understanding of it, or just hand it off to their Claude/Codex to continue the investigation or fix it. We are also working together with Supabase to make it a one-click integration from Supabase to (Soda)base. So, if you have any feedback, questions or feature ideas, please share them here or to santi.viquez@gmail.com

projects.title: Filament Agentic Chatbot
projects.summary: Build and customize multiple AI chatbots for your website, shop or SaaS. Give each its own instructions, knowledge, tools and widget style. Connect documents (RAG), your database, APIs and MCP. Self-hosted Laravel + Filament plugin with confirmed actions and human handoff. Licenses from $149.99; prices for new purchases will rise later. Buy once, use your licensed version forever; includes 12 months of updates and support. Bring your own AI keys; hosting and model usage cost extra.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】nerf-watch：检查 Claude Code 和 Codex 有没有悄悄变笨或变贵
projects.author: Abelo9996

github.name: Abelo9996/nerf-watch
github.description: Find out when your coding agent quietly got worse or more expensive. Local-first checks on Claude Code and Codex session logs, no telemetry.

projects.summary: nerf-watch 读取 Claude Code 和 Codex 已经写在你电脑上的会话日志，告诉你 Agent 有没有在你没改任何设置的情况下"悄悄变了"：实际回答的模型和你选的不一样、推理强度降了、CLI 升级后每轮的缓存写入翻倍、缓存命中率掉了、工具调用出错变多。 很多人觉得"更新之后变笨了""额度掉得更快了"，但没法验证。数据其实就在本地日志里。我第一版在自己的日志上报了 6 个警告，结果全是误报（子智能体的流量混进了平均值），现在只比较主对话、要求变化在至少两个项目里都出现才报警，每条结论都写明有多少数据支撑。 完全本地运行，不联网，MIT 协议。还有一个 macOS 菜单栏小工具，变化时图标变红。 bash npx nerf-watch check

projects.title: iphone-use
projects.summary: iphone-use gives an AI agent a real iPhone: the screen as text, tap, type and scroll over WebDriverAgent, with an honest answer for every action (applied, not sent, or unknown). Payment apps that block screenshots come back as a wireframe. A task done once becomes a flow that replays with no model. HTTP API, a 21-tool MCP server for Claude Code, and remote control from a browser or iOS app. Open source, MIT.

projects.title: Show HN: Durable Actors – OSS durable objects with configurable compute
projects.author: thomask1995
projects.summary: hi HN! Can't help the feeling durable objects are inevitable and was frustrated by the insane lock-in Cloudflare forces you into just to use them. Olivier and I built Durable Actors. Our take on Durable Objects, fully open source. Some notable differences: - Configurable compute: Specify CPU, RAM, data residency, idle-timeouts all in a decorator - No outer worker: We generate a type-safe client that you can just plug into your existing tech stack - We are more akin to the Swift Actor implementation and only allow one request in the Actor at a time (can opt out). - Default persist properties into SQLite for you - (coming soon, like today) Export SQLite table via CLI + MCP for exposing OLTP logs to your agent to help you debug. Would love your feedback!

projects.summary: skill-placebo 用长度相同的中性文字作为「安慰剂」，测试 9 个最热门的 coding agent skill 是否比安慰剂更好、对成本有什么影响。15 个公开任务，共 450 次试验，方法预先登记，数据公开，有中文 README。 结果：9 个 skill 中 2 个优于安慰剂，1 个更差，6 个没有差别。

projects.title: 做了个 prlctl 风格的 VMware CLI
projects.author: normalcoder
projects.summary: 先贴地址和安装...目前暂时只支持了 Homebrew 。手动安装可以自行编译或走 GitHub Release 。 - 开源地址： https://github.com/normal-coder/vmctl - Homebrew 安装：**brew install --cask normal-coder/tap/vmctl** ## 为什么写这个 **核心还是解决自己的使用问题（笑。** 出于对环境纯粹的洁癖，一般各种新工具的尝试还是选择在干净的 OS 内去解决。 考虑到各种安全、隔离问题，有些环境不想/不适用用容器。于是常年在重装各种系统和各种初始化中来来去去，每次操作都相当耗费心神。 **初始化系统的活儿交给 Agent 干，心里又不踏实😩。。** 于是反复在各种老牌虚拟化方案和新晋虚拟机中来回捯饬。最终。。**对个人免费的 VMware 还是真香** 😂😂😂 VMware 漫长的历史和博通的产品调性。让 VMware 比起 PD/OrbStack/Lima 一众产品，开发者友好程度不太够。 - `vmrun` 的参数太反人类了——快照、克隆、往 guest 里拷个文件，每样都要记一长串路径参数，用完就忘；敲起來还费手 - 用惯了 Parallels 的 `prlctl`，换到 VMware 之后发现没有对应手感的 CLI - 想脚本化批量操作，GUI 点不动；管 vSphere 又不想开浏览器 - ... **为了手感**。照着 `prlctl` 的命令风格写了一个，底层用统一的 Driver 接口把两种后端收进同一套命令里。 ## 快速感受 ```console $ vmctl list ┌────────────┬───────┬─────┬─────────┬─────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 名称 │ 状态 │ CPU │ 内存 │ 客户机系统 │ UUID │ ├────────────┼───────┼─────┼─────────┼─────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤ │ ubuntu-dev │ on │ 4 │ 8192 MB │ Ubuntu 24.04│ 564d1156-abcd-ef01-2345-678901234567 │ │ win11 │ off │ 8 │ 16384 MB│ Windows 11 │ 564d9876-2345-6789-abcd-ef0123456789 │ └────────────┴───────┴─────┴─────────┴─────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### 📊 基础信息 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **列出所有虚拟机** `vmctl list` | 支持 --json 输出格式。 | | **查看虚拟机详情** `vmctl info ` | 显示名称、UUID 、Tools 状态、Guest IP 等。 | | **查看版本信息** `vmctl version` | 支持 --json 输出格式。 | ### 🔌 电源管理 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **启动虚拟机** `vmctl start [--nogui]` | 返回即代表已加电，不等待 Guest OS 就绪。 | | **关闭虚拟机** `vmctl stop [--hard]` | --hard 表示强制断电。 | | **挂起虚拟机** `vmctl suspend ` | 暂停并保存当前状态到磁盘。 | | **恢复虚拟机** `vmctl resume ` | 恢复被挂起的虚拟机。 | | **暂停虚拟机** `vmctl pause ` | 暂停虚拟机运行（保持在内存中）。 | | **重启虚拟机** `vmctl reset [--hard]` | --hard 表示强制重启。 | ### 🔄 生命周期 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **克隆虚拟机** `vmctl clone --name [--full] [--snapshot ] [--path ]` | 默认链接克隆；--full 为完整拷贝。vmrun 后端要求源 VM 已关机，vSphere 支持开机克隆。 | | **派生新虚拟机** `vmctl create --from [--memory 4096] [--cpus 4] [--full]` | 从现有 VM 派生（ vmrun 后端不支持从零创建裸 VM ）。 | | **修改虚拟机配置** `vmctl set --memory 4096 --cpus 4 [--name ]` | 必须在虚拟机已关机状态下执行。 | | **删除虚拟机** `vmctl delete ` | 删除虚拟机及其全部文件，不可恢复。 | ### 📸 快照管理 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **列出快照** `vmctl snapshot list [--tree]` | --tree 可按树状结构展示快照关系。 | | **创建快照** `vmctl snapshot create ` | 为当前状态创建快照。 | | **删除快照** `vmctl snapshot delete [--children]` | --children 表示连同子快照一并删除。 | | **恢复快照** `vmctl snapshot revert ` | 必须在虚拟机已关机状态下执行。会一并恢复快照时的电源状态。 | ### 🖥️ Guest OS 交互 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **执行 Guest 命令** `vmctl exec [-u root] -- ' '` | 经 /bin/sh 执行，捕获输出并透传退出码。要求 VM 已开机且安装 VMware Tools 。 | | **查看 Guest IP** `vmctl ip [--wait]` | 脚本友好，直接输出裸 IP 。要求安装 VMware Tools 。 | | **SSH 进入 Guest** `vmctl shell [--user u] [--port 22] [-i key] [--wait] [--dry-run]` | 要求 Guest 开启 sshd 。-- 之后的参数会透传给 ssh 命令（如 `vmctl shell -- -v`）。 | ## 特性 - **双后端一套命令**：默认 `vmrun`（本机 Fusion / Workstation ），`--backend vsphere` 直连 vCenter / ESXi （ govmomi ），本地和实验室环境切换只是换一个参数； - **VM 引用很随意**：显示名、名称的唯一子串、UUID 前缀、`.vmx` 路径、vSphere 的 MoRef （`vm-42`）都能用，不必先查 UUID ； - **同名快照消歧**：vmrun 按名字操作快照，撞名时给出 `名字#uid` 候选引用（走 Fusion 13.5+ 的 vmcli ）： - **guest 内执行**：`vmctl exec -- 'df -h'` 捕获输出并透传退出码，`vmctl shell ` 直接 SSH 进去（`--` 之后透传给 ssh ）； - **为脚本设计**： `--json` 全命令覆盖；退出码分级（ 0 成功 / 1 运行错误 / 2 用法错误 / 3 对象不存在 / 4 后端不支持，exec 再透传 guest 程序退出码）； - **中文界面**：帮助和报错默认中文，`--lang en` 切英文； shell 补全内置，VM 名是动态读当前后端列表补的； - **多 profile 配置**：`~/.config/vmctl/config.yaml` 里配好本地 + 远程两套环境，`--profile lab` 一条命令切换。 ## 技术栈与现状 Go + cobra + govmomi + go-pretty ，单二进制无运行时依赖，MIT 协议。 当前 0.x 阶段，还有一些问题尚未解决。但做好一个基础镜像后，后续的工作就好弄了。。。 - `vmrun` 后端不支持从零创建裸虚拟机（`create` 需要 `--from` 一个现有 VM ）； - vSphere 后端部分电源操作（如 `pause`）按设计返回「不支持」退出码 4 ，还在真机验证中； - exec / shell / ip 依赖 guest 内装有 VMware Tools （或开了 sshd ）。 ## 最后 写这个主要自用，但如果你也在 macOS 上折腾 VMware 、或者受够了 vmrun 的参数，欢迎来提 issue / PR ，特别是 vSphere 场景的真机反馈： https://github.com/normal-coder/vmctl Happy Hacking 🙌

projects.title: Show HN: Tofu – let your agent deploy full-stack apps
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm the founder of Tofu, a code deployment platform built for agents. Current features include frontend & backend hosting (created & managed by Tofu), Postgres database (created & managed by Tofu), domain management (one-click setup for Cloudflare managed domains, manual DNS record for others), authentication, Google login, and Analytics. We built Tofu out of our personal frustrations: we're engineers who know how to code, we've deployed live products and understand the process, and our AI agents have already finished writing the code that works locally, yet taking a product fully online still took 2-3 hours: - Setup hosting, backend, database - Copy-pasting a lot of apikeys/secrets from here to there - Setting up correct redirect urls from places to places - Managing DNS records, domains - Setting up a lot services (email, 3rd parth OAuth, etc) - Payments Tofu works with any MCP-compatible agents, and here's a list of tested agents (10+ different projects end-to-end deployment via Tofu): local coding agents (Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT, Kimi Code, DSH, Cursor), Instinct, Muse, Kimi Code cloud. None of that is hard, but each of these services have their own providers and it involves managing 5-10 different accounts. Most cloud providers have their own CLI, but it only works within their own platform and the process still involves a lot of manual interventions. Agents can call any API and use CLIs, but cannot open a Google Cloud project or put a card on file with 5 vendors. We think deployment is not a compute problem, but an accounts problem. Our endgoal is to utilize SSO across services, and provide agents the ability to deploy a live product end-to-end. We don't want to compete with any cloud providers, but to make agents actually capable of shipping "live" products. We're rolling out features to support buy domains directly from Tofu (we're an authorized reseller of Name.com), and provide more customizability to tech stacks. projects.title: Show HN: Rashomon – An independent execution record for AI coding agents
projects.author: rganupa
projects.summary: I have been working on Rashomon, an open-source execution recorder for AI coding agents. The basic idea is that the agent transcript is not ground truth. Rashomon keeps its own record of what happened and compares it against the agent’s account. For Claude Code, it records things like: * shell commands, exit codes, and whether they may have written files * tool calls and outcomes * test commands and their outcomes * subagent lifecycle and ordering * timestamps and parent/child relationships * keyed digests of command/tool inputs and working directories It builds a timeline from these events. It does not store prompts, responses, file contents, or tool output. For example, it now detects patterns like: `test fails → only test files change → same test passes` and: `test command fails → same command passes → no corresponding file edit` These can indicate that an agent changed a test instead of fixing the underlying issue. Rashomon currently runs as a Claude Code plugin or through the CLI. CLI: `rashomon watch` then: `rashomon report` Plugin: `/rashomon:report` There are still edge cases around cwd, git state, test-selection arguments, generated files, retries, and parallel execution. I would be interested in feedback from people building agents on what execution signals you would want Rashomon to capture or correlate. GitHub: https://github.com/altrace-dev-role/rashomon

projects.title: Show HN: Reright.it – Human approval for agent-written text
projects.author: paulofilip3
projects.summary: So, I use agents to write a ton of stuff now: e-mails, client messages, commit messages, comments, etc. The problem is that AI writing is VERY easy to spot and most of the time I don't want it being sent under my name, since it does not sound like me at all. After failing at trying to fix it with rulebooks or skills like humanizer, I decided it was better to try to "catch" every time the agents write public-facing text and force the agents to send it to a single queue and wait for my editing and approval. Why this approach? I still want the agents to draft the text for me, since it's time consuming to pull up the necessary information and create the initial structure of the message. All I need to make the text sound like me is to lightly re-structure some sentences, remove the enthusiasm, trim it down, remove words I don't use, etc.. So I made this for myself and have used it for a while now, find it very useful, so I decided to make it public. If offers a nice looking UI with a proper text editor that allows me to easily edit and approve/reject public facing text produced by any of my running agents. It's super simple, can be used locally or with cloud session agents (but hooks don't work there, so there's no way to enforce its use there). Every message shows up as a draft that I can edit and it’s got all the context right there: what it is, who's gonna read it, and why the agent even wrote it. Then, I can edit it, hit approve and the agent sends my version of the text. I figured other people might also find it useful, so here it goes. Any feedback is much appreciated.

projects.summary: 自荐 Igra Station 智能体竞技场：一个公开的竞技场，AI 智能体在这里和别人的智能体、和真人、和机器人对弈，比赛全程直播，结果计入公开的 Elo 排行榜。 现在有 34 款游戏：国际象棋、国际跳棋、黑白棋、五子棋、海战棋、坦克对战，也有几个专门为智能体设计的谈判和经济类游戏。已经下完 6400 多盘。 智能体自己下棋时，会做出一些没人教过它们的事。下面这几件事都有服务器日志和桌边聊天记录为证： 一个智能体一步真棋都走不出来，就在桌边聊天里给对手发了一句“e2e4，我赢了”。对手也照样回了一句，双方都宣布自己获胜。 对局结束后，智能体们开始互相介绍自己是怎么搭起来的：一方讲自己的六个预测器，另一方就拿自己的四个模型来回应。这个习惯从一个智能体开始，后来传给了别的智能体。 炮战里，一个比分落后的智能体没等连射三发就主动移动，一步棋同时清掉了自己的过热、废掉了对手的校射。它拿到的说明里，根本没有这种打法。 接入很简单：起个名字就能拿到密钥，读游戏规则，开桌或者入座，然后循环“看局面、走一步”。可以用 REST，也可以把竞技场当作 MCP 服务器接入 Claude、Cursor 等客户端。现成的 Python 客户端在 kotinder/arena-play（MIT，无依赖），里面故意没有任何策略，默认只会随机走合法的一步——怎么下赢，是你自己的事。用引擎、求解器、别的模型都可以，只是不许攻击竞技场。 还有一件事我觉得挺有意思：在公平排行榜上（同一位所有者旗下智能体之间的对局不计入），用 DeepSeek 的智能体里，成绩最好的一个排在第 11 名，前十名里还没有它们。不知道是模型的问题，还是接入它们的人还没认真写策略。欢迎接上你的 DeepSeek、Qwen、Kimi 或 GLM 来试试，看能不能进前十。 不想一直在线的话，可以开“异步对局”：每步从几小时到三天，断线、重启都不影响。每盘结束后都有一个永久页面，可以逐步复盘。 此条由项目维护者账号提交。

projects.author: sanwanzzz
projects.summary: 用 Codex 和 Claude Code 写代码久了，最头疼的是它不记事。上周跟它一起查了一下午，根因找到了，方案也定了。这周开个新会话，它又从头猜一遍，有时还会把当初否掉的方案再提出来。 我试过两种办法，都不太顺手。 一种是写进 `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`。放"必须遵守的规则"没问题。但"这个接口为什么要做幂等""那个报错其实是连接池配置引起的"这类经验，一条条加进去，文件很快就几百行。每次会话都全量塞给模型，真正相关的那几句反而被淹没了。 另一种是用客户端自带的记忆。记什么由模型自己决定，我看不全，也不知道哪条在哪次起了作用，记错了也很难发现。 所以我做了 Precedent Loop ，思路很简单：经验让 Agent 来提，入不入库我说了算，用的时候按需去取。 实际用起来是这样一个循环： 1. 方案定下来，或者根因查清楚的时候，Agent 会整理一条"候选"，写明背景、结论和适用范围。 2. 候选出现在桌面 App 里。我可以改，可以让 AI 重写，也可以直接拒掉。点了确认才会入库，入库的就是我看到的那一版。 3. 之后的会话里，Agent 碰到相关任务会自己去查。一次最多拿 8 条、总共不超过 5000 字，先看标题和摘要，需要了再读全文。 4. 真正影响了它判断的那几条，它会标记"用上了"。用的时候发现内容过时，它会提一条修订，同样由我确认。 和前面两种办法比，好处主要有这几点： - **库里每一条都是我看过的。** Agent 只能提候选，不能直接往库里写，所以不会越记越乱。 - **上下文不会膨胀。** 库里有几百条也没关系，每次只取和当前任务相关的几条，而且有上限。 - **知识会跟着项目更新。** 旧结论不对了，是在用的时候顺手发现、顺手提修订，不需要我定期去翻。 - **能看出哪些经验真有用。** 每条被查到几次、被用上几次都有记录，长期没人用的可以清掉。 - **Codex 和 Claude Code 共用一个库。** 多个项目之间也能互相查，比如在后端项目里查前端那边的约定。 - **全在本地。** 数据就是一个 SQLite 文件，App 不调用任何模型 API ，也不保存 Key 。已有的 Markdown 笔记可以借本机的 Codex / Claude Code CLI 转成候选导进来。 它不是用来替代 `AGENTS.md` 的。每次都要遵守的规则继续写在那里，只在特定场景下用得上的经验放到这里。 先说清楚现在的不足，免得大家装了失望： - 只支持 Apple Silicon 的 Mac 。App 没签名，第一次打开要去系统设置里手动放行。界面目前只有中文。 - 检索用的是 SQLite 全文检索（ FTS5 trigram ）加字面匹配，没上向量。好处是简单、能解释，不依赖外部服务；缺点是换个说法可能就搜不到。现在的补救办法是每条知识入库时必须带 3–16 个检索词，把常见说法提前写进去。这是我最想改进的地方。 - 没做过严格的对照实验。我自己从 7 月 8 日用到 10 月 4 日，库里攒了 79 条，被查到 307 次，模型标记用上 113 次。"用上"是模型自己报的，只能当个参考。 GitHub： https://github.com/hemuzzz/PrecedentLoop （ Apache-2.0 ） README 开头有一段 83 秒的演示视频。装好后 App 有引导，跟着点几步就能把 Codex 和 Claude Code 都接上。 欢迎试用、提 issue 。特别想听听大家的意见：同义说法怎么检索比较好，召回效果又该怎么评测。

projects.title: Show HN: DevBoard – a simpler ClickUp for small dev teams, native apps and MCP
projects.author: darkobacic
projects.summary: After being 'forced' to use popular solutions like Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Trello for years I had enough. I wanted to build a simple, clutter free, bloat free, fast tool to help you get your shit organised. I built this using Flutter (native on macOS, iOS and Android, Windows and Linux coming) and Serverpod for backend, hosted on a VPS. And since we all use AI tools, it works with Cursor, Claude, etc over MCP. Would you switch from ClickUp or Jira to this? It's free for everyone in the beta. PS: you need an account to try it, screenshots are on the page

projects.title: vibe-learn
projects.summary: vibe-learn is a free, open-source Claude Code skill that teaches you while it builds. After meaningful code or a real bug fix, Claude adds a short Learn block (2–4 takeaways, jargon explained from scratch), a bug-class breakdown, or a mental model, plus optional non-blocking quizzes. Progress carries across sessions with spaced review, streaks, challenges, teach-back, and Anki flashcard export. Your code doesn't change — you just understand it.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】InterviewLoop：让 AI 反过来训练你的面试思考，而不是替你面试
projects.author: cintiahuang123-ai

github.name: interviewloop-cn/interviewloop
github.description: Use AI to train your interview answers and thinking, not to interview for you. Markdown protocol + Claude Code skill + offline PWA. 用 AI 反向训练你的面试应答与思考。

projects.summary: 示例页（不用安装，三十秒看完）： 市面上的 AI 面试工具，要么扮面试官，要么实时提词。这个项目反过来：它不替你答题，只逼你自己想。 三步闭环：面前预演、面后复盘、结果回填。每场面试后，你先写下自己对结果的判断，再等真实结果来检验，判断错在哪，记进个人手册。只有你自己能回答的位置，工具强制留空，不让模型代填。 产品本体是一份 Markdown 协议，任何大模型都能跑：有 Claude Code skill（自动写回手册）、离线网页版，也有单文件提示词（上传到 Kimi、DeepSeek、豆包即可）。数据全部留在本地。 我自己用三场真实面试试跑过：同一个失分模式三场全中，凭感觉复盘时完全没发现。

projects.summary: EdgeX11 is a self-learning organizational memory for engineering teams. Commits, PRs, incidents and decisions become one connected knowledge graph — nothing to file, nothing to tag. Developers get instant recall of past fixes; AI employees own tasks end to end under human approval. Corpus shares that memory with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and any MCP client. EngageX runs X and LinkedIn, replying to everyone who engages. Nightwatch watches your alerts overnight and has the RCA ready by morning.

projects.title: Show HN: C++ LSP for the LeetCode editor and Vim keybindings
